items.html:
Rewards and points have an instant pull. They attract customer attention. Generate engagement. And increase customer loyalty.

But only a handful of brands are able to achieve success and sustain their loyalty programs.

One such brand with an impressive ecommerce loyalty program is Mattel. In this blog, we breakdown Mattel’s loyalty program strategy, and learn why it is amongst the best.

Let’s get started.

What is the Mattel loyalty program?

Mattel is a toy and family entertainment company that owns multiple brands and portfolios in the world. Mattel has a unique business model, in which it has multiple partners in the toys industry. Their brands include Barbie, Hot Wheels, Fisher-Price, American Girl, Thomas & Friends, UNO, Masters of the Universe, Matchbox, Monster High, and Polly Pocket, among others.

Mattel eCommerce loyalty program breakdown and lessons

There’s a lot that goes into the planning, designing, and running of loyalty programs. From the type of program to the benefits and perks to the structure and more, brands have to get every aspect right.

Not just that, brands also have to offer something unique and exciting in their eCommerce loyalty programs. In this section, we look at all the features that make the Mattel loyalty program much loved by its members.

1. It has an easy sign up process

Lengthy or complicated sign up processes are amongst the top reasons customers avoid registering to loyalty and rewards programs. Mattel’s sign up process is easy and takes just a few steps.

Customers that have signed up for the customer account are automatically registered for the loyalty program and start earning points.

Tips and best practices:

  • Have a short sign up form that does not ask for too many details
  • Automate a thank you message upon successful sign up
  • Instantly send reward points for instant gratification

2. Many benefits to reward program members

An effective loyalty program is one that offers many benefits to members. Only points are not enough to keep customers engaged. Today, eCommerce brands use various tactics to sustain their loyalty programs, for example, gamification in loyalty programs helps increase engagement.

Apart from this, there are numerous tactics and benefits that brands mix within their programs. The Mattel rewards program offers multiple benefits. Here are some:

  • Reward points for every purchase made on the website
  • Points for creating an account
  • Points for updating profile
  • Points for following Mattel’s social media pages
  • Points for sharing with friends
  • Exclusive promotions, such as double points
  • Exclusive events for reward program members

Tips and best practices:

  • Incorporate brand engagement tactics when planning rewards
  • Make it easy to collect a lot of points and rewards
  • Make the rewards valuable and worth your customers’ time and effort

3. Easy to redeem points

Offering points for various activities is one part, the other is making it easy for members to redeem points. Many loyalty programs make it extremely hard for customers to use points.

Moreover, some brands don’t explain clearly the process of redeeming points. This can leave customers frustrated and feeling cheated. Mattel avoids this by making it simple and straightforward. Making it easy to redeem points is also one of the best customer retention strategies for brands, as members then keep coming back to redeem and earn more points.

Here’s how members can use their Mattel loyalty program points:

  • During checkout, members can select a reward they want to apply to the basket by selecting it from a drop down. The amount gets deducted from the total
  • 100 points equal to £5, 200 points to £10, and 500 points to £25
  • Members can redeem points up to £25 in a single transaction

Tips and best practices:

  • Help your customers with redeeming points, guide them through the process
  • Send them reminder messages and notifications about collected or expiring points
  • Make points redeeming exciting by creating targeted campaigns

4. The Mattel loyalty program is free

Even though both paid or free loyalty programs are known to do equally well, free programs tend to attract more members. It also allows brands to nurture a wider customer base.

However, people tend to not value things that are free. That is why it becomes necessary to make the loyalty program exciting and engaging. Some ways to do so are: incorporating gamification in loyalty programs, offering a variety of perks and benefits, adding tiered loyalty programs, among other strategies.

Tips and best practices:

  • If you are offering a free loyalty program membership, include a tiered structure to create levels and offer perks accordingly. This adds excitement
  • If you are offering a paid loyalty program, ensure the rewards and benefits are valuable and also distinguish one level from the other
  • Assess the fee of your loyalty program from time to time and make adjustments

5. Easy cancellation policy

Customers don’t like it when they are bound or do not have flexibility. When it comes to memberships, this specifically applies to cancellations, among other factors. Cancellation processes that are tedious and hard, or come with hidden costs, can easily put off customers.

Mattel loyalty program cancellation is easy. All that members have to do is call a specified phone number. Members can cancel their membership at any time.

Another positive take away from this eCommerce loyalty program is that members can use their balance reward points even after they cancel their membership.

Tips and best practices:

  • Allow members to cancel but set rules in such a way that it does lead to losses to you
  • Automate post-cancellation messages to stay connected with the customer
  • Assist members through the cancellation process if they need it

Ecommerce loyalty program trends to adapt to

Whether you’re interested in knowing more about toy brand rewards or in customer loyalty strategies across industries, there are many loyalty program trends you should know about because these can help make or break your rewards program. Here are some trends:

  • Customers are looking for value in loyalty programs. What does “value” mean? Think emotional connections, community feeling, gamification, and a sense of belonging – just some factors to consider.
  • Loyalty members communities are growing. Loyal members are not just looking for good deals, but also to engage with other like minded community members. For instance, for a toy brand, members would be interested in engaging with other members to talk about related topics.
  • Cross-generation loyalty programs are more successful. From Gen Z to baby boomers, to Gen X, today’s consumer base includes multiple generations. And brands that offer loyalty programs have to cater to the needs and preferences of different generations, not just one or two.
  • Tech-based digital experiences are a must. Think voice search, augmented reality, virtual reality, apps, AI and gamification in loyalty programs. It’s essential to adopt these technologies into loyalty programs to get the most out of it.

items.html:
Food and beverage is one of the fastest growing industries. There are new brands, new food items introduced across markets, and a lot of experimentation going on, in both the offline and online spaces.

With brands, restaurants, and home chefs adopting eCommerce models, the industry is seeing increasing competition.

And one strategy that’s a must-try for brands is bundling.

In this blog, we look at food and beverage bundling ideas that you can use for your Shopify store.

Let’s get started!

What is product bundling for food and beverage?

Product bundling is a marketing strategy that involves creating bundles or sets of multiple products, sold together. Bundles have one total price for all the products in the set, and often have a discount attached to it. The idea is to sell more by offering a discount on products. This way, brands can increase the average order value (AOV) and customers can buy products by paying less. Bundles also offer convenience to customers.

Benefits of product bundling for food and beverage stores

Product bundling offers many benefits to both eCommerce retailers and customers. While some are immediate, other benefits are for long-term and help brands meet long-term business goals. Let’s look at some of the benefits of product bundles in F&B.

Increase average order value (AOV)

Customers usually buy just one or at most two numbers of a product when they buy food. However, beverages tend to have a longer shelf life and hence customers could buy more than just one. With food and beverage bundling ideas, retailers can increase the average order value.

Clear stock and inventory

Food and beverage products often have a short shelf life, and hence, need to be sold out in time. Or else, it could lead to losses. Food and beverage bundling helps F&B brands strategically clear inventory and ensure their stocks are sold out before the expiry dates.

Enhance customer experience

Customers are always looking for something new and exciting to keep them engaged. And one way to give them a good experience is to offer something new and variety on your eCommerce store. This is where bundles come in. Food and beverage product bundles can help attract customers and offer them a good shopping experience.

Food and beverage bundling ideas you can try

When it comes to food and beverage bundling ideas, the sky’s the limit. With so much variety in food and drinks, you can think as creatively and as strategically as you want, to ensure your bundling strategy is successful. Here are some types of F&B bundles you could create:

1. Meal prep kits

One of the most trending food and beverage bundling ideas is meal prep bundles. With people’s lives getting busier than ever, meal preps have become the most popular way of managing daily meals. They offer convenience, speed, and people ensure healthy eating.

There’s a lot that brands can do with these bundles. Here are some meal prep bundling ideas:

  • Vegetarian and non-vegetarian meal prep kits
  • Salad meal prep kits
  • Kits based on cuisine, for example, Asian, Mediterranean, etc.
  • Kits based on age groups, for kids, adults, senior citizens, etc.
  • Customizable meal prep kits

2. Snack variety packs

Another effective food and beverage bundling idea is to create snack bundles. Snacks are amongst the fastest-selling food items. Besides, when it comes to snacks, customers like variety, and there is a lot of it in the market. But you can make your snack bundles even more exciting. Here’s how:

  • Create themed snack packs, for example, for game night or movie night
  • Offer mixed snack packs
  • Offer multi-pack snack bundles, for example, pack of 5 or 6
  • Offer brand-based packs, for example, one brand or multiple brands
  • Healthy snack packs, including roasted products, dried nuts, etc.

3. Subscription boxes

Food and beverages are products that customers buy repeatedly. As they have a short shelf life, customers have to restock them at regular periods. This makes it a perfect option for offering subscription boxes. Bundle subscriptions can provide convenience and cost benefits to customers. Here are some snack box bundling strategies.

  • Offer coffee, tea, or wine subscription bundles
  • Fresh vegetables and fruits weekly subscription bundles
  • Snacks and soft drinks subscription
  • Gourmet bundle subscription, for items such as cheese, etc.
  • Subscription boxes offering cookies, cakes, etc., for example, curated boxes

4. Themed bundles

When done well, bundling strategies can help keep things exciting and customers engaged. For instance, themed bundles can be highly effective in promoting food bundles online. These bundles are based on specific themes and the ideas for these bundles can be as creative as one wants. Let’s look at some fun themed bundle ideas for F&B.

  • Movie night, game night and party bundles for food and beverage
  • Picnic and barbeque food and beverage bundles
  • Winter special F&B bundles
  • F&B bundles for festivals, such as Christmas and New Year
  • Special fast-selling F&B bundles with bestsellers
  • Kids gifting bundles

5. Diet-specific packs

Today, a large population follows one or the other diet, for instance, vegan, vegetarian, keto, etc. This offers an opportunity to food and beverage brands to offer diet-specific food bundles. However, these may cater to a niche and small segment. But one way to overcome this challenge is to offer a variety of diet-specific bundles. Here are some diet-based food and beverage bundling ideas:

  • Vegan F&B bundles
  • Keto bundles
  • Gluten-free food and beverage bundles
  • Mediterranean diet packs
  • Calorie-based diet bundles
  • Customized diet-bundles that customers can pick and choose

6. Gift hampers

Come festive seasons, and stores are full of F&B gift hampers. And online stores can offer gift hampers too. Offering gift hampers online can make customers’ shopping experience better and more convenient. Apart from this, discounts on bundles can offer price benefits. Let’s look at some F&B gift hamper ideas:

  • Offer gourmet food gift bundles
  • Offer mix and match bundles where customers can pick and choose products
  • Gift hampers for different occasions, such as birthdays, festive season, anniversary, etc.
  • Offer brand-specific gift hampers for food and beverage
  • Offer fixed bundles or mix and match bundles

7. Seasonal bundles

Food and beverages can also be seasonal, especially if you think of local or regional brands. This food and beverage product bundling idea can also be applied to packaged food products. This type of bundle has many benefits, too. For example, brands can introduce seasonal products to customers, help with inventory management, and customers get to try new items based on seasons. Here are some season F&B product bundling ideas:

  • Summer drinks bundle
  • Winter special veggies and fruits bundles
  • Monsoon house party pack bundle
  • Winter hot drinks bundle, with hot chocolate, tea, coffee, etc.
  • Limited-time seasonal produce bundles, for example, winter berries bundle

8. Starter pack for new customers

Many new and small F&B online businesses struggle to find new customers and increase sales, because customers often hesitate to buy from new brands. This is where starter pack bundles can help brands with sales. Here are some ideas:

  • Offer mini packs in the starter pack
  • Offer customized options where customers can pick and choose products
  • Bundles for beverages, for example, mixed sampler bundles
  • Sample bundle for wines or kombuchas

9. Drink pairing bundles

In food and beverage, there are a lot of things that have to be complemented. Every food item may not pair well with every drink. This is another food and beverage bundling idea that eCommerce retailers could play with. Let’s see how:

  • Coffee and cookie bundles
  • Tea and savory snack bundles
  • Wine and cheese bundles
  • Fresh juice and baked goodies bundles

10. Limited edition curated boxes

To keep things exciting and engaging, F&B brands could also try limited edition curated bundles. These bundles could be an effective strategy for gourmet, luxury F&B, or small boutique brands. The limited-edition factor could add exclusivity and a sense of FOMO, urging customers to go for these bundles. Let’s explore some ideas:

  • Limited-edition wine box
  • Limited-edition curated chocolate box
  • Limited-edition coffee or tea bundles
  • Limited-edition curated boxes for festivals
  • Themed limited-edition boxes, for example, special boxes during Christmas

Examples of food and beverage bundles

1. Wine Chateau wine bundles

The brand offers various types of wine bundles, for instance, regional bundles based on specific vineyards, bundles based on brands, mixed brand wine bundles, etc. With every bundle listing, the brand highlights the savings on the bundle, making it attractive for customers to make purchases.

2.The Active Bod meal prep bundle

The brand focused on offering healthy food and beverage options for women also offers a set of bundles. The bundles are creative and thoughtful, for example, time-saving bundles for busy women, weight loss bundle, healthy eating bundle, and more.

3. Flavia coffee starter bundle

Another brand that offers creative and exciting bundles is Flavia. They offer coffee bundles, such as those based on different coffee types, variety packs of teas, etc. The sheer variety and options of bundles can attract customers and engage them, also ensuring they keep coming back to try more.

Product bundling is an effective strategy for Shopify food and beverage stores. And with increasing competition in this market, it’s a must-do for brands.

And that’s where fashion product bundling strategies can help brands.

In this blog, we take a look at product bundling for fashion and apparel brands, why it works, how to go about it, and more.

Let’s get started!

What is product bundling for fashion and apparel?

Product bundling is a marketing strategy in which brands sell multiple products as a bundle with one price tag, often offered at a discount.

Fashion product bundling strategies work well for this industry for many reasons. Fashion and apparel is one of the most vibrant industries, customers are always looking for new and exciting offers. Bundling tactics make customers’ shopping experience more exciting.

Fashion retailers often use bundling strategies such as, selling multi-pack t-shirts or socks; gifting bundles for babies; theme-based fashion bundles – for example, winter wear bundles, and more.

The benefits of fashion product bundling strategies

Bundling strategies for fashion and apparel brands offer many benefits to brands. From increasing the average order value to enhancing customer experience, in this section, we explore some of the benefits of bundling strategies for fashion brands.

1. Increase the average order value (AOV)

When customers buy more instead of just one product, it directly increases the order value. For instance, when it comes to fashion and clothing, customers usually tend to buy just one number of any product, say, one pair pants or a shirt. However, when offered as a bundle of two or three, the average order value increases, even if there’s a discount on the bundle.

2. Helps clear unsold stock

In the fashion and apparel industry, trends change quickly. There are new styles every season. This makes it critical for brands to sell out their inventory stock fast, because otherwise, it may not get sold. This is where fashion product bundling strategies help. When an old stock product is bundled with new products, the chances of it getting sold are higher.

3. Enhance customer experience

Today’s customers have become used to receiving help while shopping from brands. For instance, they expect brands to share product recommendations, help with styling tips, etc. This is another reason why clothing bundle deals for eCommerce help brands. Bundles that are created thoughtfully, keeping customers preferences in mind, are more appealing and useful for customers. This improves their shopping and brand experience.

4. Introduce new products to customers

Fashion product bundling strategies also provide an opportunity to eCommerce brands to add new products to the mix. For instance, when there’s a new product in the inventory or if there’s a slow-moving new product, retailers can add these products to bundles along with other fast-selling products. This way, brands can introduce new products to customers, and customers too, get to discover new items.

Types of product bundles fashion and apparel stores should use

The competition in the fashion and apparel industry is quite high. The apparel market is expected to grow 2.61% from now to 2029. And with this growth will increase the competition between brands. To beat competition and stay ahead, fashion and apparel brands could try these bundling strategies.

1. Wardrobe essentials bundles

One of the most simple, yet effective fashion product bundling strategies is to team up all the basics in one bundle. For instance, basic t-shirts, a pair of denims, a pair of shorts, a shirt, etc. Such wardrobe essentials bundles are useful to customers, and hence, fast-selling. For eCommerce retailers, this could be a star product in their inventory.

2. Seasonal outfit sets

People also tend to buy fashion and apparel based on seasonal changes – another interesting clothing bundle deal for eCommerce fashion brands. For instance, winter clothes, monsoon essentials, summer clothes, etc. Seasonal outfit bundles are an effective marketing strategy. To boost its sales, add a promotional offer to it, discounts or free shipping.

3. Workwear bundles

Another type of fashion product bundling strategy is to club workwear together as a set. For instance, a bundle of trousers, shirt, shoes, tie, and other accessories. Working professionals are busy and have less time to spend on shopping. Workwear bundles can be an easy and quick way for them to shop online. It’s also a good strategy for accessories and apparel cross-selling.

4. Athleisure kits

When it comes to fashion and style, athleisure wear is also a key product type. The athleisure market is estimated to grow at a CAGR of 9% from 2024 to 2030. People often tend to buy items like leggings, t-shirts, sports, bras, etc. together as a set. This gives a good opportunity for eCommerce fashion retailers to offer athleisure bundles at discounted prices.

5. Sustainable fashion sets

With the world moving towards more sustainable fashion choices, brands have started focusing more on this consumer need. This offers an opportunity for brands to cater to specific customer preferences. Brands can create personalized bundles of various types, for example, wholesale bundles, multi-pack bundles created in collaboration with other sustainable brands, subscription bundles, for example sustainable socks bundle subscription, among others.

6. Mix-and-match bundles

56% of consumers can become repeat buyers when there’s personalization and customization. Customization as one of the fashion product bundling strategies for brands, can prove to be beneficial. It can increase average order value (AOV) and customer lifetime value (CLV), and loyalty.

You could offer mix-and match bundles allowing customers to choose the products they want to add to their sets. For example, have a high-value mandatory product around which customers can choose other products.

7. Occasion-ready packs

In today’s fast-paced life, people often don’t find enough time to prepare for special occasions and events, such as parties, vacations, weddings, etc. Offering occasion-ready packs for fashion and apparel can be an effective strategy for upselling as well.

For instance, put together outfits, shoes, and accessories for different occasions, for him and her, kids, and babies. This type of bundling strategy also works for accessories and apparel cross-selling.

8. Accessories add-on bundles

To keep your customers engaged and your bundles strategy exciting, you will have to keep experimenting and offering something new consistently. One such fashion product bundling strategy is to offer add-on accessories bundles.

For instance, offer bundles of accessories to go with clothes – think bags, jewelry, shoes, ties, etc. This sort of accessories and apparel cross-selling can not only improve sales, but also enhance customer experience.

9. Limited edition capsule collections

One of the tactics that fashion brands use to attract and engage customers is to offer limited-edition products. Customers love them because of the exclusivity factor. Bundling limited-edition products can be profitable due to the high-values attached to limited collections, and create a buzz because of FOMO and urgency factors.

10. Starter packs for new customers

Let’s say your brand offers sportswear. New customers may not easily make purchases because people are particular about sports apparel. In this case, you could offer starter pack bundles. Starter packs would make it easy for new customers to try out your products. Add an extra discount for first-time buyers to increase the potential of sales.

11. Gift bundles

Another type of fashion product bundling strategy that is effective is gifting bundles. The good thing is, there can be various types of gift bundles. For instance, gifts for her and him, for kids, for senior citizens, for birthdays, anniversaries, etc. Gift set clothing bundle deals for eCommerce may include products like ties, scarves, t-shirts, socks, sets of tops, etc.

12. Discounted multi-pack deals

A common bundling strategy used by fashion and apparel brands is creating multi-pack sets. For example, a set of 3 or 5 t-shirts available at a discounted price. The products could be different or variations of the same product (variant bundles) in terms of color, design, pattern, etc. This strategy helps in boosting fashion sales with bundles.

Fashion product bundling strategies examples

Here are some examples of fashion and apparel bundles for some inspiration.

1. Winter wear bundle by Ystylish

The winter clothing bundle by Ystylish includes winter essentials, such as parka, vest, and sweater, offered at a discount. The brand not only mentions the percentage saved but also the original and the discount price, making the bundle pricing more attractive for customers.

2. T-shirt bundle by H&M

One of the most popular fashion product bundling strategies, H&M offers t-shirt bundles. The brand offers bundles for men, women, and kids, too. With multiple choices of colors and style variations, the brand makes the bundles attractive for customers.

3. Fashion kits by The Kit

This fashion brand offers luxury clothing bundles in order to improve inventory management and for sustainability. The brand believes when customers buy bundles, they reduce buying more clothing. This way, the already-existing inventory gets sold out and there is less wastage from the fashion industry.

items.html:
The beauty and cosmetics industry is booming. And with the boom, competition is increasing.

To beat competition, brands need to consistently come up with marketing and promotional tactics.

An effective tactic to increase sales and average order value for beauty and cosmetics brands is product bundling.

In this beauty product bundling guide, you’ll learn the most useful tips and strategies for your Shopify beauty store.

What is beauty product bundling in beauty and cosmetics?

Product bundling is a marketing strategy used by various types of businesses, including beauty and cosmetics. In this method, multiple products are sold as one group or bundle with one price tag.

Product bundling is an effective strategy for beauty and cosmetics brands because of the nature of the products. People buy these products repeatedly. Hence, when bought in multiples as a bundle at a lesser price, it can be beneficial for them. These factors make cosmetics bundle deals lucrative for customers.

Benefits of beauty and cosmetics product bundles

Before we get into the core part of this beauty product bundling guide, let’s explore some benefits of beauty and cosmetics product bundles.

1. Increases average order value

When customers buy bundles, they buy more than one product and pay for more than one. This directly increases the average order value (AOV). For instance, instead of buying one bottle of shampoo, customers will end up buying a pack of two or three, and thus, pay more per order. Increasing AOV with beauty bundles is an effective strategy because customers prefer to buy bundles for price benefits.

2. Easy to introduce new products through bundles

With bundles, eCommerce retailers can easily mix and match old and new products. This is an easy tactic to introduce new products in your inventory to your customers. Given the nature of beauty and cosmetics products, customers often hesitate to apply new products on their skin and refrain from buying new items. Bundles help overcome this challenge.

3. Clear inventory

Beauty and cosmetics products have a shelf life and thus, have to be sold within a specific time. Cosmetics bundle deals help increase sales and thus clear inventory. Besides, when products are bundled strategically—a few new products combined with one or two from old stock—inventory can be cleared. Another way to clear inventory via cosmetics bundles is to create multi-pack bundles, such as a pack of three or five.

4. Enhances customer experience

With so many cosmetics and beauty products available in the market, it’s easy for customers to feel confused. And so, brands try to make purchase decisions easier for them. Beauty and cosmetics bundles are one such strategy that drives purchase decisions. This improves customers’ shopping experience.

Types of product bundles beauty and cosmetics brands can use

A study found that consumers save, on an average, 8% when they purchase bundles compared to buying products individually. But for eCommerce retailers, the challenge is to choose the types of bundles and bundling strategies. In this section of our beauty product bundling guide, you will learn the various types of bundles you can create for your beauty and cosmetics brand.

1. Makeup essentials bundles

When it comes to cosmetics, one of the best bundling ideas is to put together essentials. For example, facewash, lotion, primer, foundation, and similar such basic products.

This kind of bundle with basic products being offered at a discounted rate works well as it impacts human psychology. When customers see cost benefits and savings on products they buy regularly, they make quick purchase decisions. eCommerce retailers can use multi-pack bundle types for this strategy.

2. Skincare routine sets

Another type of bundle that does well in the beauty and cosmetics industry is based on themes, such as skincare. Skincare product bundling ideas include products such as cleanser, toner, moisturizer, face wash, etc.

This type of bundle can be further enhanced by creating skin care bundles for specific seasons, such as winter skincare, summer skincare; or bundles based on skin type, such as skincare bundle for dry skin, etc.

3. Seasonal glam kits

Beauty product bundling can also be based on seasonal luxury or glam themes. For instance, our skin requires different types of care based on seasons. One way to ensure consistency in sales is by offering seasonal glam kits, for example, summer glow bundle, winter hydration bundle, etc.

These bundles can also be offered as makeup and skincare gift sets. This strategy can also help to introduce new seasonal products via bundles. Besides this, brands can clear out unsold inventory by strategically bundling products.

4. Best seller bundles

Like every other industry, beauty and cosmetics also have bestsellers. For brands, this is a great opportunity to create bundles of best-selling products.

Best sellers can be combined with slow-moving products to balance out sales. Moreover, you can also club high-value products with best sellers to increase the value of the bundle.

Bestseller bundles also lead to a higher conversion rate because the products in the bundle get sold out at a much higher rate compared to others.

5. Beauty and cosmetics travel kits

Another effective skincare product bundling idea is to create travel bundles. Travel beauty and cosmetics bundles can be promoted by offering a discount during the holiday and travel seasons.

There’s a lot brands can offer through travel bundles. For instance, create bundles based on geography or locations based on the weather.

As travel season is limited to certain times during the year and is short, you could try FOMO and urgency tactics to increase the sale of these bundles. For example, ‘Get 25% off on a Summer Travel Bundle only this week’.

6. Customizable beauty bundles

Wherever there’s customization, its appeal instantly increases for customers. That’s because they can buy products that are more relevant to their needs.

So how do you create customized beauty bundles? An effective method is to keep one fast-selling or high-value product around which customers can choose other products they like and create their own customized bundle.

7. Event-ready collections

Beauty and cosmetics products are also in demand during special events, such as weddings and parties. By offering event-ready bundles, you can make customers’ experience enjoyable and add convenience.

Besides, there is a lot of scope for event cosmetics bundles. Think weddings, engagements, Christmas, New Year, and other special occasions.

Also read: Glossier Beauty and Cosmetics Product Bundle Strategy Breakdown for Shopify Stores

8. Gift sets

Offering beauty gift bundles creates opportunities for customers to buy unique gifts. It also reduces their gift-selection woes, making the shopping experience enjoyable.

Moreover, you can create a variety of bundles, such as makeup and skincare gift sets, bundles for him and her, birthday bundles, etc. To elevate the experience, you can think of packaging tips for beauty product bundles to make them suitable for gifting.

9. Starter kits for beginners

Another effective bundling strategy for beauty and cosmetics is to create starter bundles. This bundling strategy focuses on new products and also new customers.

For example, customers might not want to invest in full-size packs when trying a new product. But they wouldn’t mind buying a starter pack for trying out the products.

10. Subscription bundles

Driving recurring sales of bundles is possible with subscription bundles. Many beauty and cosmetics products need to be replenished within a month or every few months. Offering bundle subscriptions can benefit customers with discounted pricing, convenience, and savings.

For eCommerce retailers, subscription bundles are a way to keep customers engaged, satisfied, and build long-term relationships with.

11. Limited edition collab boxes

Another way to keep your customers engaged is by offering something new from time to time. For example, offer limited edition collab bundles. Collaborate with another brand to include complementing products in your bundles.

Such bundling strategies for beauty and cosmetics brands can create a perception of added value and excitement. Also consider exciting packaging tips for these beauty product bundles. Pack them differently to make them look exclusive.

12. Flash sale bundles

This bundling strategy for beauty and cosmetics products focuses on offering limited-period offers on bundles. It works on urgency and FOMO.

By combining products strategically, beauty brands can drive conversions via flash sale of bundles. For example, combine a new product or a fast-selling product with other slow-moving or high-value products in bundles.

With flash sale bundles, customers can get cost benefits and discounts and brands can increase sales and AOV.

13. Problem-solution kits

When it comes to beauty, many people have specific issues that need attention, for example, dry skin, acne, hair fall, etc. Problem-solution bundles are designed to meet these specific needs of customers.

Problem-solution bundles work well as they are targeted at specific goals and tailored to customer needs. The products in each bundle are more relevant to different customer segments as they address their pain points.

Examples of beauty and cosmetics product bundles

1. Pixi

This UK-based cosmetics and beauty brand’s bundles offer various options, from family bundles to beginner kits, to bundles that are created to target beauty issues.

2. Pure

Pure offers gift sets for skincare, body sets, facial bundles, and more. The bundle price is mentioned alongside the actual total price of all the products, which makes it attractive for customers to make purchases for discounts.

3. The Beauty Crop

The Beauty Crop offers a wide variety of bundles at special discounts. For example, customers can choose from mystery box subscription bundles, most-wanted bundle with best-sellers, summer special bundles, and more.

items.html:
One of the most vibrant industries is the health and wellness industries. It is also an evergreen industry and is not seasonal.

However, with increasing competition from new brands springing up every other day, and brands launching new products, competition is fierce.

One way retailers can ensure more sales is through product bundling. In this blog, we look at effective health and wellness product bundling strategies that you could apply in your Shopify store.

What is product bundling in health and wellness?

Product bundling is a sales and marketing method under which many different or multiple products are sold as a bundle or set with one price tag on the whole bundle.

Product bundling strategies work well for the health and wellness industry. Health and wellness products are often bought repeatedly at regular intervals. It is also a vibrant industry that consistently has new products being introduced in the market. These factors make product bundling a lucrative and effective strategy for the health and wellness industry.

Health and wellness product bundling offers more value to customers, helps eCommerce brands increase average order value (AOV), and makes it easier for brands to sell inventory evenly.

A quick illustration that gives a peek into the global health and wellness industry:

Source

Health and wellness product bundling benefits

Bundling strategies for wellness brands provide many benefits to eCommerce retailers, from increasing the order value to improving customer experience and more. Here are some of the benefits:

1. Increase average order value

One of the biggest benefits of bundling strategies for wellness brands is it helps increase the AOV. Typically, customers would buy one bottle of health supplements. But with bundles, they end up buying more because of the savings factor. This directly increases the AOV of each customer. Even though the bundles are on a discount, when priced strategically, it benefits eCommerce retailers.

2. Improve customer experience

With so many products available, customers tend to get confused. Unlike a physical store where a sales person helps customers make purchase decisions, on the eCommerce store, customers often find themselves alone. But when bundles are created thoughtfully, customers find them appealing and useful. This improves their shopping experience, and is an important benefit of bundling for wellness stores.

3. Clear dead stock and inventory

Health and wellness products have expiry dates. And hence, retailers have to ensure their stock gets sold before the products go bad. Health and wellness product bundling helps retailers strategically clear inventory. For instance, bundles could include products that need to be cleared. Another strategy is to create multi-pack bundles, for instance, a pack of 5.

4. Introduce new products to customers

Bundles give an opportunity to retailers to add new products to the mix. Retailers can also think of cross-selling ideas for health products via bundles. For instance, customers may otherwise hesitate to buy a new product, but if it is a part of a bundle along with other premium items, they wouldn’t mind trying it.

Types of health and wellness product bundles

From wellness subscription box bundles to upselling health products with bundles, in this section, we have put together a list of product bundling strategies for health and wellness brands.

1. Buy more save more bundles

It is human psychology to take an action that leads to more savings. For example, buy 3 products and get 5% off; buy 4 products and get 10% off. When customers choose bundles with more products—multi-pack or wholesale bundles—they end up saving more money.

Buy more, save more bundles help brands increase the order size and the AOV, thus increasing the overall sales volume and revenue. For instance, a brand selling vitamin tables offers two multivitamin supplement bottles for a reduced price.

2. Seasonal wellness kits

In the health and wellness products industry, seasons play a key role. For instance, there are some products that are specially needed in the winter season, for example, skin balms.

Seasonal wellness kits are a common type of health and wellness product bundling strategy. Some examples are, winter skin care bundles, or holiday skin care bundles. Health and wellness brands curate bundles with a variety of products, offering a discount on the entire bundle.

This strategy is also helpful for introducing new seasonal products that brands add to their inventory. Moreover, brands can also get rid of unsold stock by adding specific products.

3. Starter packs for new customers

When it comes to health and wellness products, customers are cautious about using new products on their body and skin. This opens a good opportunity for starter packs. Starter pack health and wellness product bundling includes small sample size products.

For example, a cosmetics starter pack could include a cleaner, toner, moisturizer, and face wash. One of the best advantages of this type of product bundle is it can make conversion of first-time buyers into loyal customers easier.

4. Subscription bundles

In subscription bundles, customers receive bundles at a pre-defined interval. Instead of placing single orders every time, with subscriptions, customers sign up for subscriptions once and keep receiving bundles regularly.

Subscription bundles provide discounted price, savings, the convenience of getting orders delivered regularly without having to place orders, and the ease of managing shopping without any hassle.

With this model, health and wellness brands can keep customers engaged with new products and regular communication.

5. Goal-based packages

Most people have goals when it comes to health and wellness. For example, goals related to weight loss or mental wellness. Goal-based bundles are designed to meet these specific goals.

Goal-based health and wellness product bundling strategy works well as it is tailored to specific objectives. The products in each bundle are more relevant and address customer pain points. These types of bundles work well specifically for customers looking for solutions for specific problems and also during certain times of the year, for example, around the new year.

6. Limited edition curated bundles

Limited edition curated bundles are created with the intention to offer exclusivity and create excitement for customers. These function on the principles of urgency and FOMO because they are limited in number.

Limited edition curated bundles may include exclusive health and wellness products, newly launched products, or may be planned based on a theme. For instance, a limited edition haircare bundle, or a luxury collection curated bundle.

7. Complementary product sets

Another health and wellness product bundling strategy that works well is complementary product sets. Imagine a product bundle that includes a yoga mat, a bottle of body lotion and a pair of sunglasses. The three products do not complement each other. A complementary product bundle includes products that go well with each other.

For the health and wellness industry, complementary product bundles enhance customer shopping experience by making their purchase decisions easier. This type of bundle can also be based on themes, for example, a health brand could offer a diabetes bundle.

8. Build-your-own bundles

Today’s customers expect and prefer personalized experiences. This is where build-your-own bundles come in. With BYO bundles, customers can pick the products they want in their bundle. For instance, there could be one key product around which customers can choose other products.

This type of health and wellness product bundling strategy increases customer satisfaction, increases engagement, and leads to a better customer experience.

9. Gift bundles

Another type of product sets are gift bundles. These are designed specifically for gifting purposes. For instance, a self-care gift set for him and her. This type of bundle makes gift shopping and gifting convenient for customers.

Gift bundles are specifically preferred during gifting and festival seasons. For example, a health and wellness gift kit for the new years or on birthdays. Gift bundles are enhanced with attractive packaging and customized cards, etc.

10. Trial size samplers

People do not like to try new products on their body easily. Even though new products may be tempting, they hesitate to buy them. However, if the products are available in small sampler size packages, customers find them more appealing to buy. If customers like what they sample, they might opt to buy the full-size products.

This is why trial-size health and wellness product bundling works well. Trial size sampler bundles can lead to higher conversion rates. Also, customers feel more comfortable trying new products if they do not have to spend more on full-size packs.

11. Loyalty program bundles

eCommerce brands that have loyalty programs can combine their bundles strategy with it. For instance, offer extra discounts on bundles to loyalty program members. This strategy not only enhances loyalty members’ experience but also leads to repeat purchases by them. Additionally, members get to earn more reward points.

12. Flash sale bundles

Another health and wellness product bundling strategy is flash sales. Flash sale bundles are those bundles on which there is a limited period offer. These are time-sensitive and function on the principles of urgency and FOMO. Flash sales strategy helps drive quick sales. This can also help brands clear inventory in a strategic manner. For instance, higher discount on a bundle of vitamin supplements for a limited period of time.

Examples of health and wellness product bundles

1. Organik Wellness & Co.

A UK-based brand that sells wellness products for babies, teens, and mothers, the bundles include options such as skincare kit, family bundle, starter bundle, and more.

2. Made to Milk

An Australian brand, Made to Milk offers cookies especially made for lactating mothers. The brand also offers a variety of bundles of cookies, sample packs, and others.

3. Freeze Frame

This skincare brand offers bundles focused on specific skin problems. For instance, their bundles include Brightening Kit, Wrinkle Kit, Skin Lift Kit, among others.

If you have a membership model set up on your eCommerce store on Shopify, you need to ramp up its appeal for shoppers to turn into members. This means leveling up the…
items.html:
Having a member-only model can guarantee long-term benefits and improve CLTV, but this can only work if you get people to join you. If you have a membership model set up on your eCommerce store on Shopify, you need to ramp up its appeal for shoppers to turn into members. This means leveling up the types of discounts you have on offer.

Here we will look at some common types of member-only discounts that have helped brands attract more customers and increase their memberships.

Types of members-only discounts we recommend setting up

These are some of the best member-only discount types that we highly recommend setting up, to see a boost in memberships:

1. Percentage-based discounts

Percentage-based discounts are one of the most common and straightforward ways to incentivize memberships. And the reason behind its popularity is that besides its simplicity, it works exceptionally well.

Members can save on most of their purchases, giving them an ongoing reason to remain part of your membership program. Be it a 10% discount across categories or category-specific discounts, there is a strong perceived value that is being created, with tangible benefits being offered that justify membership costs.

One of the most popular examples of this is Amazon’s Prime membership which offers great percentage-based discounts to its members on Prime Day.

2. Tiered discounts

By offering increasing rewards based on higher purchase value, tiered discounts for members can motivate them to spend more and reap the benefits. For instance, if a member has a total cart value that hits a specific threshold, they will unlock a higher discount percentage than what they previously availed at a lower tier.

This discount type has been successfully employed by a lot of brands to create a gamified experience with a sense of achievement while offering tangible value for the customers as they move up the tiers. Customers are encouraged to stay as members and continue shopping with the brand and are constantly rewarded for their loyalty.

This is perfectly exemplified in Sephora’s Beauty Insider program, where rewards and incentives are distributed into tiers based on customers’ annual spending.

3. Exclusive product discounts

Customers opt for memberships primarily because they expect exclusive and high-value discounts and benefits. So, providing this exclusivity is crucial to boosting memberships and loyalty. One of the best member-only discount strategies to do this is through exclusive product discounts, that appeal to the customers’ desire for special treatment.

These perks play a crucial role in differentiating your membership program from competitors and make members feel privileged.

These offers could be for limited edition collections, newly launched products, or member-only bundles. For example, a brand that offers fitness products can offer its members early exclusive discounts on their latest special-edition workout gear.

4. Early-bird discounts

Another effective member-only discount strategy is to provide early-bird discounts that provide members special access to sales, product launches, limited-time offers etc. before anyone else.

Through such preferential treatment, you can foster loyalty among your existing customers while compelling potential members to join fast to get the benefits. During key promotional periods, knowing that they will have the first chance to grab the hottest deals or popular products can drive membership sign-ups and encourage more engagement.

Amazon is popular for its Prime Early Bird special sales during major sales events like Black Friday or Prime Day:

5. Volume discounts

For brands selling consumables or items that are often purchased in multiples, offering volume discounts is a perfect way to boost memberships. This member-only discount strategy can also help boost average order values as it encourages customers to buy in bulk by offering good value for money. These discounts also create convenience for members as they can shop in larger quantities at fewer frequencies for better prices.

Costco membership is known for its excellent execution of volume discounts that offer customers significant value for larger purchases.

6. Free shipping discounts

Free shipping is, without a doubt, one of the most desired perks in eCommerce. Shipping costs are often responsible for deterring customers from completing their purchases, so offering members free shipping on all orders, eliminates this friction entirely and in place, makes for a seamless and simple checkout process.

American retail booksellers, Barnes & Noble, for example, adds significant value to their Premium and Barnes & Noble Legacy membership plans by providing free standard shipping on all eligible orders.

7. Credit or cashback discounts

Credit or cash back rewards let members earn points or cashback with every purchase they make, thus attaching a great value proposition to the membership. For example, brands can let members earn 5% cashback coupons or points for every purchase, which they can redeem on later purchases.

This lets you create an effective loyalty loop that encourages repeat purchases and enhances the long-term value of your membership program.

Starbucks offers a great example of incentivizing every purchase through “Star Points” which can be redeemed for cashbacks or free products.

8. Seasonal or holiday discounts

You can share personalized offers for members during holidays or around seasonal themes, aligning your membership program with peak shopping seasons. You can offer members exclusive deals during events like Black Friday, Valentine’s Day, and Christmas or share special summer-themed discounts, making your membership feel timely and relevant. These special seasonal member-only discounts also give customers a reason to shop from you instead of competitors during high-demand periods.

For example, during Christmas, an apparel brand can offer members a special discount on their latest winter collection or Christmas-themed products.

9. Birthday or anniversary discounts

Celebrating personal milestones such as birthdays or membership anniversaries can help create a deeper emotional connection with your members, which can go a long way in terms of inspiring loyalty. Offering special discounts during these times adds a personal touch to the membership program and is a step towards pulling the right heartstrings with a customer to induce loyalty.

These positive experiences can also turn members into active brand advocates who will bring you new member sign-ups organically. Here is how Ulta Beauty does this:

10. Bundle deals for members

Bundle deals are extremely effective at creating a sense of additional value while increasing the average order value from your members. It encourages your members to explore and purchase more products by combining related items at a discounted price.

For example; if you are a skincare brand, you can bundle together different skincare routine kits for different skin types, with a special 30% discount to VIP members, thus appealing to them with both convenience and value.

Bundling products can also help move slower-selling inventory, as they incentivize members to try new products or services that they might not have considered otherwise.

11. Flash discounts

FOMO and a sense of urgency are more powerful psychological triggers than one would think. Use flash sales to leverage this and create buzz among your members. The time limit, the exclusivity of the sale and the unique advantages that are offered, often encourage spontaneous purchases, while compelling non-members to be a part of it by joining.

MasterClass for example has a unique way of using flash sales for increasing membership. The 2-for-1 membership projects greater but for a limited-time deal, thus driving faster decisions, while appealing to both new and existing members.

Conclusion

Discounts and incentives have historically been a go-to strategy to attract more customers across diverse business models. With a perceivable and appealing value proposition, it can really impact how well your members-only subscription works.

And the best way to set up diverse and dynamic members-only discount strategies is with Appstle Subscriptions. From tiered discounts to custom shipping to bundles to other intuitive loyalty features Appstle offers everything you need to boost loyalty organically.

items.html:
Product bundles have proven to be profitable for eCommerce brands across industries.

Many health and wellness brands are offering attractive bundles. That’s because bundles help increase the average order value (AOV), increase customer satisfaction, and boost sales.

However, even if you create attractive health and wellness product bundles, you will have to come up with the right strategies that align with your customers and market, for the bundles to perform well.

This blog breaks down the health and wellness product bundling strategy of Tata 1mg, one of India’s best medical, health, and wellness eCommerce brands.

You can learn strategies that you can apply to your Shopify product bundles.

Let’s get started!

Tata 1mg – health and wellness product bundling strategy breakdown

Tata 1mg is one of the most popular eCommerce medical and health products brands in India. The brand also offers many product bundles across categories. Even though the brand is well-known, it doesn’t take its marketing and promotional strategies for granted. In this section, we take a look at its health and wellness product bundling strategy, and pull out important learnings and takeaways, which you can apply to your Shopify bundling strategy.

1. Offers a wide variety of bundles

Customers have different needs when it comes to health and wellness. And being a health and wellness product aggregator site, Tata 1mg offers a wide variety of products.

However, the brand is spot on with its health and wellness product bundling strategy. Here’s what we can learn from it:

  • There are multiple bundles focused on different needs, for example, for diabetes, weight management, elderly care, liver care, etc.
  • Each bundle is carefully curated with complementary and relevant products
  • Some of the bundle listings have discounts highlighted on the products page
  • Takeaway: Each bundle has a clear name that mentions its theme, making it easy for customers to understand the bundle components

2. Value beyond discounts

Whether it is grocery bundles or health and wellness bundles, today, customers look for quality and value or cost and discounts. Tata 1mg recognizes this.

Here’s how some ways in which Tata 1mg enhances the value of its bundles and what you can learn:

  • Mentions the use and purpose of each medicine in the title of the product listing
  • Mentions ingredients and detailed information about each product so that the customer knows exactly what they’re buying
  • Each product in a bundle is related and complementary, enhancing the overall value of the bundle. For instance, a weight management combo pack includes products meant for detoxification, and metabolism improvement, too
  • Takeaway: Talk about factors related to your brand and products to enhance the perceived value of your product bundles. For example, they could be sustainability, organic products, quality, and other non-price attributes

3. Shows ratings with each health and wellness bundle listing

Ratings and reviews help customers make purchase decisions. For brands, these are elements that can help increase sales and the time customers spend on the website exploring products.

Here’s what we can learn from Tata 1mg:

  • The brand shares ratings and reviews with every product bundle listing
  • Ratings are mentioned out of 5 stars along with the number of ratings and the number of reviews
  • The ratings and reviews are mentioned at the end of the page where visitors can read the full product reviews

4. Offers themed bundles

Tata 1mg creates a cohesive shopping experience by offering themed or curated bundles. This helps keep confusion at bay. Customers know how the brand has created bundles—based on specific diseases and needs—and how to look for a bundle that meets their needs.

Let’s look at some takeaways from their themed health and wellness bundle strategy:

  • It has disease-based themes as well as organ-based themes (For example, diabetes, and liver, respectively)
  • It also has generic theme bundles, such as first-aid kit
  • The brand also offers bundles of healthy juices, apart from medicines, and supplements

5. Personalization

Although Tata 1mg bundles may seem generic, there is a certain level of personalization. While lifestyle products, such as cosmetics and groceries are easy to personalize, with health and wellness products, there is little scope for personalization.

Let’s see what Tata 1mg approaches personalization for its health and wellness bundling strategy:

  • The brand address specific concerns and diseases with targeted bundles
  • The bundles are marketed to customers for specific needs, making it more relevant and targeted
  • The brand creates bundles based on market trends and customer needs
  • This strategy positions the brand as a solution provider in the health and wellness eCommerce market

6. Detailed information

Even though information about every product is just a quick online search away, it is important for health and wellness eCommerce brands to mention important details on their website.

Here’s how Tata 1 mg incorporates this aspect:

  • Clear communication of the products in each bundle
  • Highlight benefits and usage of the bundles
  • How the product works and key ingredients in the product
  • Savings when bought as a bundle
  • Mentions the original price and discounted price
  • Shows images of every product, making information more clear

Also read: Best Pricing Strategies for eCommerce Product Bundles on Shopify

7. Impactful marketing

Not just offering quality bundles, Tata 1mg also knows that unless it markets its products and brand well, it won’t cut it with many other competitors in the market.

Key focus areas of its marketing strategy:

  • In one of its campaigns, the brand focused on emphasizing on quick delivery
  • Another campaign focused on real-life doctors who are dedicated to their patients, which helped the brand build trust among consumers
  • With one of their marketing campaigns, the brand focused on partnering with people for lead-generation
  • Apart from these campaigns, they incorporate the usual marketing strategies that work, such as discounts, email, push notification, health camps, print ads, billboard ads, etc.
  • The brand understands that it is important to share informational and educational content in the health and wellness industry. Articles, blogs, videos, are among its other content marketing strategies that is a must for health and wellness brands
  • Every product bundle page also shares recommendations for similar products, increasing product discoverability and sales potential

Key takeaways from Tata 1mg bundling strategy breakdown

  • Understanding customer needs can enhance the performance of your product bundles
  • In case of health and wellness bundling offers, it helps to understand the common diseases and health problems faced by customers
  • Ensuring the products in each bundle complement each other and go well together is important
  • Enhancing the value perception of the bundles by mentioning factors, such as discounts, benefits, can help customers make purchase decisions easily
  • Tata 1mg keeps the bundles simple, reducing confusion and complexity
  • Showing savings with the bundle listing by mentioning the original price and discounted price, or mentioning amount saved in percentage helps enhance its value perception
  • Offering a wide variety of health and wellness product bundles improves sales potential
  • Optimizing product bundle strategy by monitoring the performance of bundles and testing different product combinations and lead to better results for eCommerce businesses
  • Health and wellness brands can also leverage seasonality for their bundling strategy. For example, offer bundles related to winter health care
  • Offering limited period deals increases the potential for sales
  • Multiple payment options improves sales potential. For instance Tata 1mg offers different payment methods as well as offers for using specific payment methods.

Set up Shopify health and wellness product bundles in a matter of minutes

items.excerpt: Discounts. Reward points. Free shipping. In the hyper competitive space of loyalty programs, every brand is trying to steal customers’ attention. However, rewards and discounts may not be enough to impress today’s customers to stay loyal in the long run. So what is it that Shopify customer loyalty programs can offer to hook customers for…
items.html:
Discounts. Reward points. Free shipping. In the hyper competitive space of loyalty programs, every brand is trying to steal customers’ attention.

However, rewards and discounts may not be enough to impress today’s customers to stay loyal in the long run.

So what is it that Shopify customer loyalty programs can offer to hook customers for life?

AdiClub – Adidas loyalty program has some answers.

This blog looks at the many drivers of AdiClub, which go beyond discounts and points, and build a perception of value.

Let’s get started!

Lessons to learn from AdiClub for Shopify customer loyalty programs

Facing challenges, such as loyalty and rewards fatigue, boring points collection via monetary transactions, lack of unique loyalty programs, and surface-level engagement with customers, how should Shopify fitness stores achieve success with their loyalty programs?

We collected key takeaways from one of the best loyalty programs in the market. Read these 9 actionable strategies used by Adidas AdiClub and learn how you can apply them in your Shopify customer loyalty program.

1. AdiClub is free

As humans, it’s our tendency to love everything that comes free. Smart brands like Adidas tap into this emotional need by making their loyalty programs free of cost. Well, at least to bring customers into joining their loyalty programs.

That’s what AdiClub has done. The loyalty program is free to join. And they aren’t shy about letting customers know. Every CTA says ‘Join for Free’.

When loyalty and rewards programs are free, customers feel like they’re receiving something more. They get a feeling that the rewards and loyalty system is designed keeping their needs at the center.

2. Joining AdiClub is easy

‘First impression is the last impression.’ If you make it difficult, time-consuming, and complex for customers to join your rewards program, they may not move past the first steps.

And getting more customers to join your loyalty program is critical if you want to scale and grow your Shopify business.

Joining AdiClub is easy. Let’s see a few takeaways from the process:

  • The AdiClub page has the CTA ‘Join for Free’ multiple times
  • Customers can sign up via Gmail, Apple or Facebook
  • When customers click on the CTA, it opens a pop-up asking to sign up or login
  • The process is simple. Customers can sign up in just two clicks with minimal information

3. AdiClub loyalty program is simple and straightforward

Consumers increasingly choose brands that make their experience easy and hassle-free. No one wants to go through a loyalty program that’s complex, where they aren’t sure about how to earn or redeem points, or ways to get more benefits.

Adidas builds value perception by keeping its loyalty membership program simple and easy for customers. On the website, they explain, in three simple steps, how the program works.

  1. Register and access instant benefits: Joining AdiClub is easy. All that customers need to do is register and receive instant first points for becoming a member.
  2. Customers earn points by doing what they love: Adidas loyalty program is about the customer, which is evident from the way they designed it. Customers can earn loyalty points for activities, such as moving (think running and training), writing reviews and shopping. Customers can keep accumulating points for various activities.
  3. Redeem points: Members can redeem points and unlock exclusive experiences, products, vouchers, and more.

Also read: Predictions and Trends For Customer Loyalty Programs 2025

4. Multiple ways to earn points

Another learning for Shopify customer loyalty programs from AdiClub is to make earning points easy for customers, as well as exciting.

With AdiClub, members earn points in many ways – when they sign up and create an account, when they complete their profile, for training sessions, for participating in running events, for shopping, writing reviews, and sharing.

When brands make things difficult for customers, it can easily put them off. Conversely, when things seem easy and achievable, it taps into human beings’ inherent motivation to achieve more, accomplish, and increase or grow something.

AdiClub, thus, not only lets customers earn more points, it also increases sales, revenue, and engagement opportunities with members.

5. Offers rewards with points

AdiClub is an example of how brands can create more value for customers by offering more than just run of the mill points. Apart from points, the brand also gives rewards to members.

Fitness brands on Shopify can take inspiration from AdiClub.

Members can redeem points towards discount vouchers, members-only giveaways, points-only products, vouchers from Adidas partner brands, and contribute points towards charitable causes. These rewards enhance the loyalty program’s value perception.

So how can Shopify fitness stores apply this strategy to their loyalty program?

  • Shopify brands must align these rewards to their products and brands. That’s how rewards can become unique and exclusive to your brand, helping you stand apart in the sea of loyalty programs
  • Ensure that in the pursuit to offer unique rewards, you don’t offer things that eat into your profits
  • Make sure you are able to keep up with the rewards for a long term so that members do not feel let down and continue enjoying these rewards

6. AdiClub has 4 levels

AdiClub has four levels based on the number of points customers earn. Each level offers different perks. Creating a tiered loyalty program has many benefits:

  • You can cater to a wider range of potential members based on their spending capacity
  • Tiers enable members to shift from one level to the other based on their desires and needs
  • It gives greater opportunities to collaborate with other complementing brands – for instance, for offering vouchers, discounts on other websites/brands

Shopify fitness stores looking to start or enhance their customer loyalty programs can take inspiration and cues from AdiClub levels and perks.

Level 1

  • 0-999 points
  • Welcome bonus
  • Members-only products
  • Early access to sales

Level 2

  • 1,000-3,999 points
  • All Level 1 benefits
  • Members-only sales
  • 3 months free premium access to adidas Running app
  • Birthday gift voucher
  • Level 2 bonus

Level 3

  • 4,000-11,999 points
  • All Level 2 benefits
  • Early access to products
  • Level 3 bonus

Level 4

  • 12,000 + points
  • All Level 3 benefits
  • 12 months free premium access to adidas Running and Training apps
  • Level 4 bonus

7. Creates exciting offers and experiences

Here’s more inspiration for Shopify customer loyalty programs of fitness brands. AdiClub offers more unique and unmatched experiences to keep their members engaged. These are perks that are any sports fans’ dream.

However, there’s a catch. Members have to win these experiences by participating in contests, quizzes, and other forms of gamification.

  • AdiClub days: Members get exclusive experiences, rewards, and more during AdiClub Days
  • VIP home game: This is exclusively for members of Level 4. They get to win tickets to the Adidas box, pre-match side-pitch access, and a home jersey.
  • Signed products: Members receive products, such as football boots, t-shirts or basketball shoes signed by top athletes
  • Train with your hero: Members can complete challenges and win training sessions with their hero athletes

8. One community across Adidas apps

Adidas has a couple of apps, such as Adidas App and Adidas Running. The brand offers points for various activities on all its apps. Members of AdiClub can earn points for activities such as running, training, hiking, biking, shopping, and more. AdiClub members can earn more points by downloading and joining these apps.

Here are a few takeaways for Shopify customer loyalty programs:

  • Don’t make points accumulation feel like a task or work for members. Make points accumulation as easy as Adidas does by combining points from across apps
  • Link loyalty points and rewards to your members’ brand experience. For instance, fitness brands on Shopify can create opportunities to earn points via activities that relate to their brands – training, running marathons, etc.
  • Keep your loyalty programs fluid, think about the experiences your members would like, as opposed to equating their loyalty to monetary transactions only

9. An FAQs section

The AdiClub page on Adidas website, has a detailed FAQs section, making it easy for people to know all the basic information.

Today’s customers do not want to go through the process of contacting customer support to get simple questions answered. They’d rather do it themselves. That’s why having self-service features on eCommerce websites, such as an FAQ section helps.

AdiClub FAQs answer questions, such as why should one join the loyalty program, how one can become a member, information about points, different tiers of AdiClub, and more.

How to start a Shopify customer loyalty program for your brand?

Value, personalization, gamification, community, engagement, and unique rewards are some of the factors that make consumers, especially the younger generation consumers, to join loyalty programs of brands.

When it comes to Shopify fitness stores, there’s a lot they can do to create these experiences via their loyalty programs, for members.

To create a human-centric loyalty program that connects your sports brand with your customers, you will require an intuitive loyalty app — Appstle Loyalty & Rewards App.

The app helps you create an engaging loyalty program and manage it to align it with your customers actions, needs, and preferences.

items.excerpt: Whether it’s grocery, automobile, airlines, or live streaming – there are multiple subscription options available for all kinds of products and services.
