Get started with your Shopify producing bundles in 2025

There is a lot of potential for and opportunities for product and service bundles in 2025. With customers’ preference for bundles rising, there’s a lot you can do to make bundles a profitable part of your marketing strategy.

However, to get started, you will require an intuitive product bundling app for your Shopify store. An efficient app will allow you to automate bundling tasks, discounting, and managing bundles.

items.html:
The last few months of the year usually tend to see a drop in subscriptions and memberships.

That’s because consumers are busy shopping for products and services available at discounts during the Black Friday Cyber Monday and holiday season sales.

In between buying products for themselves, home, and gifting, consumers often don’t prioritize subscriptions and memberships.

But your Shopify store can reduce subscription and membership churn during this lucrative season. With a few strategic campaigns and tactics.

This blog looks at strategies to reduce churn of membership and subscription plans during the holiday season.

Read on!

How to reduce subscription churn

ECommerce subscriptions are a form of marketing and sales strategy wherein customers join a paid or free subscription to avail benefits and perks from brands for a continued or long-term period. For example, Netflix annual or monthly subscriptions.

During the holiday season, many brands see a drop in subscriptions. Customers rather choose to buy individual products from sales. However, you can reduce subscription churn during the BFCM and holiday season. Here are a few strategies.

1. Offer discounted price during holiday season

Many consumers may focus on shopping for products and gifts that are at discounted rates during the BFCM and holiday season. In the process, they may avoid purchasing subscriptions because they are not their immediate requirement.

However, you can increase the probability of them signing up for subscriptions by offering a discount. Here’s what you can do:

  • Promote the discount offer to existing subscribers as well as potential new subscribers
  • Create a special campaign for subscribers who are up for renewal of their subscription in the next few weeks or months – offer them a discount if they sign up during the holiday sale
  • Run limited-time, flash sale during the holiday season to increase the potential of new subscriptions

2. Offer free trials of new products to long-term subscribers

One of the benefits of subscriptions is that brands can introduce new products to customers much more easily. Customers also get an opportunity to discover and try new products.

You can leverage this advantage during the holiday season to reduce subscription churn. Here’s what you can do:

  • Segment long-term customers into one group and share a personalized offer of free trials of new products, only available during the holiday season
  • Create a segment of dormant subscribers and share this offer to entice them to become active subscribers again
  • Utilize data from their past orders to understand their likes and interests and then offer relevant products for free trials

3. Allow subscribers to build their own box

Customers value flexibility. And that is why 91% of top-performing retail subscription merchants offer customers the ability to make changes. One such flexibility option is to allow customers to build their own subscription box; in other words, choose the products or services they want.

Use this tactic to reduce subscription churn during the holiday season. Here are some cues:

  • Introduce build-your-box subscription during the holiday season for fixed subscription box plans – make subscription experience exciting
  • Promote build-a-box subscription as a gifting option for the holiday season as customers tend to shop for gifts during this time
  • Offer different denominators for build-a-box subscription to cater to different customer preferences and budgets

4. Personalize holiday season subscription offers

One of the biggest reasons customers cancel subscriptions or leave brands is a lack of personalization. Personalization has become a standard expectation of consumers. Infact, 75% of customers are willing to pay more for personalization.

Here’s how you can provide a personalized subscription experience this holiday season to reduce churn and engage customers for the long term.

  • Utilize data to create personalized subscription boxes and plans. With personalization, you can differentiate the regular holiday season offers from your subscription offers and generate customer interest
  • Even if shoppers don’t sign up for subscriptions during the holiday sales, you can retarget them soon after the sale ends. Customers tend to shop multiple times during the entire holiday season period. Hence, set up retargeting strategies
  • Use an efficient Shopify subscription app, such as Appstle, which automates personalization features, data collection, etc. This will enhance your personalization strategies

5. Create special holiday campaigns to highlight members

Customers sign up for memberships not just for price benefits, discounts, and free shipping. Becoming members and a part of a community also adds value to their lives.

For instance, members love to be a part of communities that brands build where they can engage and interact with other like minded people. The holiday season is a time to make this experience stronger. Here’s how.

  • Create campaigns to highlight member achievements, for example, show the members who have earned highest points or the most number of badges or benefits
  • Run contents where members can participate and highlight how your Shopify membership helped those members
  • Offer free gifts to members who have maintained a good member profile by participating in activities throughout the year

How to reduce membership churn

Memberships are a marketing and sales strategy wherein customers sign up for a membership to avail various kinds of perks and benefits from brands. For example, Amazon Prime – by paying a membership fee, customers can avail benefits such as free deliveries, express deliveries, early access, etc.

In this section, we look at some strategies to help you reduce membership churn on your Shopify store during the holiday season.

1. Offer a free gift to members for the holiday season

We humans are wired to feel good when we get something over and above the usual, for example, gifts. Offering your members a gift during the holiday season can greatly impact their perception of your membership program.

Here’s what you can do:

  • Offer a free gift to members for renewing or joining your membership program during the holiday season
  • Ensure the gift is valuable and resonate with your members
  • Segment members based on tiers and offer different gifts to different tiers
  • Offer holiday-themed gifts to make the experience more relevant

2. Offer free delivery for all holiday season membership orders

Another strategy to reduce membership churn during the holiday season is to offer free deliveries to members. Free shipping is one of the most attractive incentives for customers. Study shows that 93% of customers shop more if there’s free delivery. Here’s what you can do:

  • Offer free delivery to members only to encourage customers to join membership
  • Set a minimum spend amount to avail free shipping
  • Allow members to choose from a selection of gifts – offering their favorite products as gifts is one of the biggest selling points and can help reduce membership churn

3. Offer in-person community events experiences

Today, customers like to be a part of communities facilitated by their favorite brands—meet and discuss the products and services with likeminded people. Customers want experiences that add value to their lives and don’t want to limit their association with brands to transactions only. So, here’s what you can try:

  • Organize in-person meet and greet events for your Shopify members
  • Urge customers to sign up for membership during the holiday season by promoting these member community events
  • The holiday season is a time for celebration. Organize different types of events for your different membership tiers. For example, an awards function for members – award most active member, highest points earning member, oldest member, etc.

4. Offer a free trial period for membership

Another effective strategy to reduce membership churn during the holiday season is to offer your membership for a free trial but only during the holiday sale period. Let’s see how you can make this offer exciting for customers:

  • Offer your membership for free for a few days during the holiday sale
  • Create special email and social media campaigns to engage these free-trial members, making the campaigns exciting. For instance, share engaging blogs, articles, and videos through campaigns
  • Let members try out a new product as part of the membership trial
  • Integrate an intuitive Shopify memberships app such as Appstle

5. Improve engagement before the holiday season

Customers come across hundreds of brands on a daily basis. Hence, if you slack in keeping them engaged or communicating with them, it’s easy for them to forget about your brand. In the meantime, your competitors could easily grab their attention.

Here’s how you can improve member engagement much before the holiday season to reduce churn.

  • Be proactive, create engagement campaigns to ensure you are on top of your customers minds
  • Use surveys, review and feedback forms, one on one interactions to understand their membership experience and how you could make it better for them in the coming year
  • Try to reconnect with lost subscribers – those who canceled their subscriptions in this year. Offer them attractive pricing and incentives to rejoin

How will you reduce subscription and membership churn this holiday season?

The strategies and tactics you employ to reduce churn of subscription and memberships would depend on your brand, products and services. What’s important is you definitely put together a plan and prepare for the holiday season to get more sign ups and reduce churn.

items.excerpt: Every year, eCommerce brands see the highest sales during BFCM. Brands offer the highest discounts and best deals they can to compete with other brands. items.html:
Every year, eCommerce brands see the highest sales during BFCM.

Brands offer the highest discounts and best deals they can to compete with other brands.

However, that’s not the only way brands can leverage BFCM. Brands running subscription models can boost sales during the sale and for the future too. But most subscription brands don’t try to.

This blog focuses on innovative subscription strategies for BFCM for securing more sales.

Let’s get started!

Subscription strategies to boost subscription sales and engagement

You may not emphasize on subscriptions during the BFCM sale as your main focus in products and discounts. However, by implementing some carefully thought strategies, you can drive sales and interest in your Shopify subscription plans.

You can drive immediate sales of subscription plans or build long-term customer relationships that can lead to customers converting to subscribers in the future. Here are some strategies you definitely want to consider.

1. Offer exclusive discounts for subscriptions

One-time tempting offers are hard to resist for customers. Create offers and deals around subscriptions available only for the BFCM period.

Here are some ideas:

  • Offer an exclusive discount deal on subscriptions specially for BFCM
  • Highlight savings by clearly mentioning how much customers will save with the offer
  • For existing subscribers, you could offer discount on referrals’ subscriptions
  • Here’s an example: ‘Subscribe now and get 50% off your first three months—only available during BFCM.’
  • Show appreciation for subscribers by sending them personalized messages and emails offering them one-time discount codes

2. Limited-time offers and scarcity tactics

Shoppers are in a frenzy during the BFCM sale. With so many great offers all over the internet, they may forget about your offers pretty soon.

But there’s a tactic to increase the probability of them making purchases on your site faster—scarcity and FOMO. These strategies for subscription during BFCM can help your regular and new customers get started with their subscription journey. Here’s what you can do:

  • Create limited-time offers on your subscriptions
  • Add countdown times on product pages to create a sense of urgency
  • Offer a limited number of subscriptions at discounted price
  • Display social proof, such as ‘50 subscriptions sold out, only 10 remaining’
  • Incentivize shoppers to subscribe by offering attractive gifts to first 10 subscribers only during BFCM
  • Create seasonal and festive subscription boxes that are available only for a few days during Black Friday Cyber Monday

Source

3. Bundle subscriptions with one-time purchases

Combine your Shopify subscriptions with products and create bundles. However, ensure you focus on BFCM, exclusivity, personalization, and showing the value of these bundles. Here’s what you can do:

  • Take a reverse approach—recommend products based on customers’ browsing data and combine with a subscription, offer a discount
  • Encourage new, one-time customers to opt for a subscription at a discounted price as part of a bundle to turn them into repeat customers
  • Offer a subscription if customers buy a specific number of products. For example, ‘Buy 5 products and get a subscription at 50% discount’.
  • Create limited-period bundles for BFCM only—combine popular star products with holiday and festive season products
  • Create DIY bundles with your best selling products. This gives customers a sense of flexibility to choose their subscription products

4. Provide free trials or first delivery free

Another way to boost subscription sales during the BFCM period is to offer free trials. This can help reduce customer hesitation and increase confidence. Apart from this, you could offer a few free deliveries, for example, first two subscription box deliveries free.

However, you must emphasize and highlight that the offer is BFCM-exclusive and will remain only for a few days. You could use this BFCM subscription strategy to reignite the interest of dormant subscribers or those who haven’t renewed their plans. This could lead to old subscribers rediscovering your subscription plans without you having to make a significant investment.

5. Use SMS and email marketing for personalized campaigns

There’s nothing like personalization—when all other brands are sending generic promotional messages to customers, you can stand out by creating personalized campaigns. Here’s what you can do:

  • Send out personalized emails and SMS with offers crafted based on customer data
  • Set up automation on your Shopify store subscriptions to target abandoned carts
  • Create subscription offers combined with other products and offerings
  • Incorporate dynamic content in emails, show savings with a subscription vs. one-time purchase
  • Show appreciation for your subscribers by sending them personalized deals and incentives during the BFCM time

6. Leverage upsell and cross-sell tactics

BFCM is also a great time to upsell and cross-sell because there are good discounts on all products. And with subscriptions, there are many opportunities for upselling and cross-selling. Let’s explore what all you can do:

  • When customers buy individual products, offer a subscription upsell during checkout
  • Integrate a Shopify subscriptions app such as Appstle to easily use upsell and cross-sell features
  • If you have different tiered subscription plans, try to upsell a higher value plan to customers during BFCM at a discount
  • Display exclusive product drops only available to subscribers to increase sign ups during BFCM
  • Segment customers based on products they might like so that you can increase the potential of them subscribing to a subscription plan during BFCM
  • Another strategy for subscriptions during BFCM is to promote the idea of gifting subscriptions as it is gifting season

Source

7. Offer VIP perks for subscribers

Subscribers look at quality over quantity. To ensure a valuable subscription experience, offer perks that customers would value. Let’s look at some VIP perks you could offer during BFCM with subscriptions.

  • Early access to new products and collections
  • Exclusive benefits, such as discounts, points, rewards, etc.
  • Make subscribers a part of a special community
  • Combine social causes and charity with subscriptions to enhance customers’ experience
  • Highlight perks for subscribing during the BFCM sale, for example, during checkout
  • Promote subscription perks in your BFCM campaigns to differentiate subscription offerings from regular purchases

8. Use social proof and testimonials

An effective way to sign up more subscribers during the BFCM period is to show social proof to customers. Let your BFCM shoppers know what other subscribers think about your subscriptions, what they like about it and how they’re using it. Here’s what you can do:

  • Show customer reviews and testimonials that talk about the benefits and positives of your subscriptions
  • Display testimonials with success stories of current subscribers, emphasizing how they benefit from the service
  • Show different reviews that focus on multiple aspects, such as convenience, affordability, special experiences, etc.

9. Run retargeting ads for subscription offers

You may not be able to sell subscriptions to all your BFCM shoppers during the sale period or while they’re shopping. However, that doesn’t mean you cannot entice them to subscribe. Make retargeting ads a part of your subscription strategies for BFCM. Retargeted users are 8 times cheaper to reach per click.

  • Use social media channels to run retargeting campaigns
  • Run retargeting ads on Google
  • Mention BFCM-exclusive subscription deals in the ads
  • Target shoppers who showed interest in subscriptions as warm leads are easier to convert

10. Highlight subscription flexibility

Another way to encourage customers to sign up for subscriptions is to let them know how flexible your subscription plans are. Today’s customers want convenience and flexibility. They do not want to feel like they’re stuck with something. Here’s what you can do:

  • Show them how easily that can manage their subscriptions via your Shopify subscriptions app
  • Let them know they can cancel their subscription plan whenever they want
  • Show them they can easily move around deliveries, swap, pause, change products, etc.
  • Add banners and pop-ups to emphasize on these flexibility features

11. Partner with influencers and affiliates

Another effective subscription strategy for BFCM and the holiday season is to partner with influencers and affiliates. 69% of people trust influencers for recommendations. Let’s explore what you can do:

  • Leverage influencers and affiliates following by partnering with multiple influences from different industries
  • Start your influencer marketing campaign much before the BFCM sale begins to get a head start
  • Create custom discount codes for influencers to share with their audience. This helps boost credibility and reach

items.html:
The BFCM and holiday season sales are just about to begin!

Have you figured out your discounts and deals for this year? If not, it’s time you get started.

In this blog, we explore product bundling strategies for BFCM and the holiday season to drive more sales, engagement, and profits for your Shopify store this year!

Let’s get started!

Product bundling strategies for BFCM and holiday season

Product bundles are a favorite when it comes to annual sale seasons such as BFCM and festive seasons. Explore these 15 bundling strategies and see what aligns with your goals this year.

1. Curated holiday gift bundles

People often feel confused about things to give. To remove this confusion, created themed gift bundles. Make their gifting decisions easy. Here are a few ideas for product bundling strategies for BFCM curated gifts.

  • Create bundles for different audience segments, for example, Gifts for Her, Gifts for Him, Tech Lovers Gift Bundle, Holiday Skincare Set, etc.
  • Put together complementary products that go well together
  • Create promotional campaigns for ready-made gift bundles

Here’s an example:

2. Buy more, save more bundles

Another bundling strategy that works well during the holiday and festive season is ‘Buy more, save more’. As people buy gifts in large quantities, this type of bundle can be cost-effective and make holiday gift shopping easy for customers. These gifting bundles can be effective for products that are commonly gifted or repeat purchases, such as fragrances, candles, etc. Here are some ideas:

  • Offer tiered product bundles, for example, bundle same products – Buy 2 Save 10%, Buy 3 Save 15%
  • Bundle complementing products- Bundle 1 with 3 products 10% discount, Bundle 2 with 5 products 20% discount

3. Exclusive BFCM bundles with limited-edition products

Festive season is also a time when people want to buy something unique and exclusive. You can create bundles to match this requirement. Doing so creates urgency and makes your holiday bundles more desirable. Let’s see how:

  • Offer limited-edition products in your BFCM bundles
  • Create bundles available for a limited period
  • Include holiday or festive special products in the bundles

4. Create upsell and cross-sell bundles

Upselling and cross-selling related or supplementary products can increase revenue up to 10% to 30%. These can also be used as product bundling strategies for BFCM and holiday season. Not only do they increase average order value (AOV) and sales, but also the potential of repeat purchases from customers. Here’s what you can do:

  • Bundle together products that complement each other in a set
  • Create many such bundles in different categories
  • Include a high-value product in the bundle to ensure a high AOV
  • Offer a bundle at a discounted price at checkout to increase the AOV

5. Bundle subscription offers with products

If you offer subscriptions on your Shopify store, BFCM and the holiday season is a good time to promote it through your bundle. Not only do you increase long-term customers, you extend subscription benefits to more customers. Here’s what you can do:

  • Include your subscription within the bundle along with other products or services
  • Make it a once-in-a-year offer for a limited period to encourage customers to buy it
  • For example, get a 3-month servicing subscription for your water filter when you buy it during the BFCM sale

6. Free gift with bundles

When customers buy more, they expect something more in return, for instance, a gift or another freebie. A study found that 60% of consumers would rather receive a free item than a discounted one. Use this in your favor by trying these strategies:

  • Offer free gifts when customers purchase BFCM and holiday season bundles
  • Create multiple bundles but offer free gifts only with the high-value bundle to increase sales of that bundle
  • Offer customized product bundles where customers can add products but offer free gifts on minimum spend. For example, buy a bundle worth $100 and get a free gift

7. Bundle best sellers with new products

You must be having some star products in your inventory – products that are fast selling and high value. Double up on these best sellers by bundling other products with them. Here are a few ways to do so:

  • Pair your best sellers with less popular products or those that are hard to sell. This way, you increase the potential to sell slow-moving items
  • Pair best sellers with new products. This way you can introduce new products to your customers easily
  • For example, bundle your best-selling night cream with a new face mask and offer 10% off

8. Customize build-your-own bundles

Customization can be a game-changing product bundling strategy for BFCM. When you allow customers to build their own bundles, they get a sense of more freedom, flexibility, and convenience, increasing the potential for sales. Here are some cues for you.

  • Keep one high-value core product and allow customers to choose the other products they like. This helps maintain an AOV
  • Allow customers to choose products from different categories. This way you can ensure all categories get sold
  • For example, pick any 1 nail paint and 1 hair spray and bundle with X perfume; buy the bundle at 25% discount

Source

9. BFCM exclusive family or group bundles

There are many products that have a high demand during the BFCM and festive time. For instance, candles, Christmas decor, chocolates, wines, etc. An effective product bundling strategy for BFCM is to offer family- or large-sized bundles.

  • Based on your past BFCM sales data, pick products that customers tend to buy in large quantities, put together as a bundle of 3 or 5 or 10 and offer different discounts
  • Create family bundles where customers get one or two of the same products free. For example, buy 3 bottles of wine and get one free
  • Combine new products with regular items to make it easy for customers to discover new products

10. Flash sale bundles

Urgency and FOMO are effective tactics that work during the BFCM and holiday season sales. Customers do not want to miss out on good discounts. This is why adding flash sales into your BFCM strategy can work well. Do this:

  • Create time-sensitive flash sale bundles. For example, ‘Buy a set of 5 t-shirts at 40% off; offer available only today’
  • Use countdown timers on your website to build urgency and excitement
  • Send notifications on WhatsApp and other channels to announce flash sales in real time

11. Seasonal essentials bundle

BFCM and the holiday season are around the end of the year and winters. Focusing on winter-themed products and bundles can bring better sales results. This enhances customers’ shopping experience and makes it easy for them to shop seasonal essentials and goodies. Let’s see some ideas for product bundling strategies for BFCM and holiday season:

  • Put together winter accessories in a bundle and offer at a discount only during the BFCM sale
  • Create a curated box of winter goodies and sell as a bundle during the holiday season
  • Offer a bundle as part of your regular subscription. For example, a curated Christmas-themed bundle in your regular delivery
  • Create holiday and travel-themed bundles

12. Offer digital product bundles

BFCM and the holiday season are also a good time for brands that sell digital products, such as online courses, ebooks, entertainment subscriptions, and more. Let’s see how you can bundle digital products.

  • Offer a selection of digital products at a discounted price
  • If you do not sell digital products, collaborate with other brands to add a digital product into your regular BFCM bundle
  • Personalize your BFCM offers based on customers’ past purchases, interests, etc.

For example, ‘Buy any 5 courses as an annual bundle for the price of 3’.

13. Exclusive subscription box for the holidays

If you offer subscriptions on your Shopify store, the BFCM and holiday season is a good time to create a special edition subscription box. Here’s what you can do:

  • Put together premium products, holiday-themed products, and high-value products in a bundle
  • Use the opportunity to offer this premium subscription bundle at a discount
  • Also invite new customers to subscribe at a once-in-a-lifetime special BFCM discount

14. Collaborate with other brands for bundles

You may have a limited number of products and limited categories in your inventory. But that doesn’t mean you should miss out on bundling strategies. You can partner, team up and collaborate with other brands that complement your brand.

  • Collaborate with brands that sell complementing products and services to create a bundle specially designed for BFCM and holiday sale
  • Create promotional campaigns to promote these bundles
  • For example, ‘Buy holiday special bundles including your favorite products from Brand 1 + Brand 2, only available during BFCM’

15. Product bundling strategy for BFCM gifting

Harness the gifting traditions and trends by creating bundles specially designed for gifting. Promoting bundles for gifting and creating focused campaigns can make your gifting product bundles strategy stronger. Do this:

  • Put together bundles specifically for gifting purpose
  • Add a festive packaging
  • Offer personalized messages to go with the bundles
  • Pre-wrap and allow customers to choose gift wrap to make it more engaging and exciting

Best practices for product bundling strategy for BFCM

Follow these best practices to avoid common mistakes and make the most of your BFCM product bundling strategy.

  • Pricing strategy: Have a clear pricing strategy that does not confuse customers. Show savings clearly in amount and percentage compared to purchasing items individually.
  • Word your campaigns properly: Words such as ‘exclusive’, ‘discounts’, ‘limited time deal’, and ‘holiday special’ attract customer attention. Ensure your BFCM and holiday season sale copy is different from your regular campaigns.
  • Promote your BFCM and holiday season offers: Your customers are on different channels, hence, promote your offers heavily or customers may miss out. Use email, social media, website banners, third-party websites, etc.
  • Use Shopify bundle apps: Make your BFCM and holiday season sale strategy more effective and successful by using a smart Shopify bundles app, such as Appstle Bundles & Discounts.

items.html:
BFCM and holiday season sales are popular amongst consumers.

Customers not only buy from their favorite brands, but also don’t hesitate to buy from new brands to avail discounts and deals.

For brands, this is a great opportunity to add to their customer list.

However, what brands need to focus on is not just one-time sales, but how to build loyalty for the future.

This blog explores customer loyalty and rewards strategy for BFCM and holiday to help grow your

10 customer loyalty and rewards strategies for BFCM and holiday season 2024

eCommerce brands see a lot of traffic during the BFCM and holiday season sales. To turn these sales into returning customers and repeat sales, you will have to think strategically. Try these 10 customer loyalty and rewards program strategies you can combine within your BFCM and holiday season sales plans this year.

1. Double or triple loyalty points during BFCM

There’s intense competition during BFCM and holiday sales. With so many brands offering tempting deals, you could easily lose your customers to competitors. Hence, give them more reasons to shop with you by offering double or triple loyalty points on purchases made during the sale time.

Use this customer loyalty and rewards strategy for BFCM to increase the chances of customers coming back to your store to use up their reward points. For example, offer 3x or 5x points on all purchases during the BFCM sale.

2. Exclusive early access to BFCM sales for loyalty members

Customers feel special when you make them feel special and give them exclusive deals. One such incentive is early access to BFCM and holiday season offers. When you give your loyalty members a head start, they feel valued. This feeling of exclusivity makes them want to come back to your store for more and stay loyal for a long time.

You could create special campaigns only for your loyalty members to announce these deals via SMS, email, etc. For example, “Shop before anyone else. Exclusive early access to our Black Friday sale only for our loyalty members.”

Source

3. Exclusive BFCM discounts for loyalty members

Brands offer heavy discounts to everyone during the BFCM sale. But that doesn’t mean you must neglect your loyalty members. You must use this opportunity to make them feel more special. Offer members-only discounts during BFCM to make loyalty members feel special.

Your loyalty members definitely expect you to offer them something exclusive even during the sale time. For example, you could do this: ‘Members save an extra 15% over and above the BFCM deals! Use this special member code: XXX’

4. Holiday-themed tiered rewards

Anothercustomer loyalty and rewards strategy for BFCM is gamification or tier-based approach. Gamifying your BFCM and holiday season incentives can add that extra excitement customers crave for. For instance, try these holiday-themed tiered loyalty and rewards ideas:

  • Create challenges themed around BFCM and holiday season. For instance, set spending thresholds for customers to earn extra rewards – spend $500 and receive back bonus loyalty points
  • Offer surprise loyalty points during BFCM sale. This will increase loyalty member excitement. Promote by sending announcement via email, SMS, WhatsApp only to loyalty program members

5. Offer free gift with purchases for loyalty members

Research shows that 90% of consumers say they would purchase more from brands that offer free gifts with a purchase. Adding a free gift with purchases during BFCM and holiday season sales can enhance loyalty members’ experience and make them want to associate more with your brands.

A few things you could do are: offer a free gift on the purchase of a specific amount or more or offer a free gift code on a purchase after the BFCM sale is over. That way you can ensure customers keep coming back to your store.

For example, ‘Purchase items worth $150 during Black Friday sale and get a free gift.’

6. Reward points for referrals during BFCM

Incorporate referral programs as a customer loyalty and rewards strategy for BFCM. BFCM is also a great time to leverage the high-traffic to your Shopify store for your referral program. For instance, encourage your existing customers to share referrals. In return, offer them incentives.

For this, you could run a special campaign to combine the referral program and BFCM sale. For instance, ‘Refer a friend and earn 1000 bonus loyalty points.’ Mention this offer during checkout as well as post purchase via email, SMS, etc.

7. Loyalty program sign up incentives

Many new, first-time customers may visit your eCommerce store during the BFCM sale, besides your existing customers. Encourage new customers to join your loyalty program by offering bonus points or an exclusive incentive.

Ensure you highlight the benefits of joining your loyalty program while shoppers are browsing your product or at the time of checkout. This will increase engagement and spark their interest in your loyalty program, increasing the potential of becoming repeat customers.

For example, ‘Sign up for our loyalty program at checkout and get 1000 bonus points to shop on your next purchase.’

8. Personalized rewards based on purchase history

If you aren’t using your Shopify data to personalize customer experience, you’re missing out on many benefits. Consider using part purchase history to personalize rewards as a customer loyalty and rewards strategy for BFCM.

For example, use data to understand which products loyalty members buy repeatedly. During the BFCM sale, offer rewards and incentives on those specific products.

You could also segment your loyalty members based on various parameters and send them personalized offers via different channels, such as email, SMS, etc.

Here’s an example: ‘ As a frequent buyer of X, get 20% off your next purchase on the same product during the BFCM sale.’

9. Holiday gift cards and points for gifting

BFCM and holiday seasons are also a time when people give a lot of gifts. Consider promoting gift cards as a reward within your loyalty program. For instance, offer bonus points to customers who buy gift cards, or allow customers to redeem points for gift cards.

Offering gift cards during the BFCM sale can offer many benefits to retailers – increase brand loyalty, improve customer experience, ensure locked-in income, and can help with stock clearance during sales.

Here’s an example, ‘Earn 500 points for every $50 gift card you purchase during our BFCM sale.’

10. Exclusive holiday-themed rewards

Another customer loyalty and rewards strategy for BFCM is to offer exclusive holiday-themed rewards. For instance, you could create an elaborate campaign focused on holiday-themed rewards.

Introduce limited-period BFCM rewards that can be redeemed through your loyalty program. For example, allow customers to redeem rewards only during holiday sales. This will create urgency and excitement around earning points.

Today, eCommerce consumers are always fishing for exciting deals.

One effective marketing tactic brands are adopting is offering product bundles or sets.

Bundles help increase average order value (AOV), enhance inventory management, boost customer satisfaction, and increase sales.

However, few brands succeed with bundles. One such brand is Gunner Kennels, a pet supply eCommerce store.

This blog takes a deep dive into its pet supply product bundles strategy. We’ll explore the brand’s bundle strategies, why customers love it, tips and takeaways you can apply to your eCommerce product bundles.

Let’s get started!

Gunner Kennels pet supply product bundles: a breakdown

Gunner Kennels is a US-based pet products brand. The brand, dedicated to designing the best quality pet products, is known for its crash-resistant dog kennels. The brand offers kennels, bowls, food crates, food scoops, name plates, straps and more. The brand also understands personalization is key when it comes to pets and offers pet name plate personalization.

Apart from its individual products, Gunner Kennels pet supply product bundles are a customer favorite. The bundles include kits comprising a kennel, strap, name plate, and kennel bed. The bundles are available in different sizes and for different purposes.

Another key feature of their pet product bundles is the possibility to customize the bundles. The brand offers three variant product bundles to choose from.

Now let’s explore the many features that make this pet product bundle strategy one to learn from.

1. A dedicated section for bundles

Gunner Kennels has created a dedicated page for pet product bundles. Customers can find the page tab in the shop dropbox. The bundles page clearly displays the three bundle options.

The page displays the images of the bundle, the name of the bundle, its price, amount saved, and what the bundle includes.

Shoppers can explore the bundles further by clicking on each individual bundle. A key highlight feature is the ‘Customize your setup’ tab that allows customers to click and open a page where they can customize their bundle.

2. Limited bundle options

Online shoppers have thousands of products at their fingertips. And having too many options leads to decision fatigue – a scenario where one cannot make purchase decisions because of confusion.

Gunner Kennels addresses this issue by keeping their pet supply product bundle selection simple and limited. The brand offers three bundles only – Performance Bundle, Weather Bundle, and Long Haul Bundle.

However, the highlight of their bundle strategy is that these three bundles can be customized. This gives customers the flexibility to adjust their bundles and at the same time makes it easy to choose between just three types.

Customization has many benefits:

  • Provides flexibility
  • Makes purchase decisions easy for customers
  • Adds a personalized touch to the bundle
  • Increases sales potential

3. Clear product bundle description

Instead of an elaborate description, the bundle information is kept to the point and minimal. No text-heavy paragraphs and flowery words; just clear information.

Each bundle mentions the basic details such as price, savings, color, etc. This makes it easy for customers to compare the three bundles, spend less time deciding, and adds clarity.

Here’s a recap of the way the brand shares product details:

  • Clear and to-the-point details
  • No extra, text-heavy descriptions
  • Simple language and neat display

4. Option to customize pet supply product bundle

59% of online consumers are more likely to buy from brands that offer customization. The percentage of Gen Z consumers who buy customized products is 75%.

Brands that offer customization are winning in the eCommerce market. Gunner Kennels is one of those brands. Its customers can simply choose the color and size, tie down strap color and type, size of bed, and add their dog’s name.

These personalization and customization features packed into one bundle are key drivers that help increase sales.

5. Prioritize bundle visibility

Even though each of the brand’s products can be bought separately outside of the bundle, Gunner Kennels ensures high visibility of its pet supply product bundles.

Here are the things that make their bundles seen:

  • A dedicated page for bundles
  • Clear images for each bundle
  • Neat presentation
  • Limited number of bundles
  • Detailed and to-the-point information on each product of the bundles
  • Savings on each bundle mentioned
  • Customization option with each bundle

6. Clear bundle pricing strategy

Gunner Kennels has three pet supply product bundles with different prices. However, each bundle has a $50 savings. This is clearly mentioned alongside the price of each bundle.

Having a clear pricing strategy has many benefits for brands. Customers do not get confused. Clear pricing makes customers’ purchase decisions easy. Moreover, customers have clear expectations and do not spend time comparing the three bundles.

This sort of tiered pricing for bundles encourages higher spending and increases the average order value (AOV). Not only does this bundle pricing strategy cater to different customer segments, but also drives them to opt for higher-value product bundles for their pets.

7. A dedicated section for reviews and testimonials

Pet parents can be extremely particular about what products they buy for their furry friends. Gunner Kennels understands pet parents’ emotions. 7 out of 10 customers prefer to read reviews before making purchase decisions.

The brand has a dedicated page for sharing customer reviews and testimonials. This section shares images shared by customers and their stories alongside. The brand takes the opportunity to highlight product features below the testimonials. This improves the sales potential of the products and bundles.

Product bundling is more than just a sales strategy; Gunner Kennels understands this. Their idea is to offer value to their customers. Hence, the brand has thoughtfully shared product reviews to help shoppers make purchase decisions and feel good about their purchases.

Key takeaways from Gunner pet supply product bundle strategy

Here’s a summary of Gunner Kennels pet supply product bundle strategy that makes it a preferred choice for customers.

  • Gunner Kennels has created a dedicated page for its pet kennel bundles
  • The brand keeps it simple by offering a limited number of bundles
  • Customers can read all important details and information about the product on the bundles page as well as click on each product for more details
  • Every individual product of the bundles is described in detail
  • Clear images and descriptions make it easy for customers to understand the product
  • Customers can clearly see the price benefits and the amount of savings on each bundle

Bundles are an attractive marketing tactic for eCommerce stores.

Not only do they increase the average order value (AOV), bundles also help with inventory management, increase customer satisfaction, and drive more sales.

But even though you may have great bundles to offer, you will have to come up with the right strategies to ensure the bundles perform well.

This blog breaks down Glossier’s strategy of beauty and cosmetics product bundles. You’ll learn the brand’s bundling strategies, why their bundles are customers’ favorite, and tips you can use for your Shopify bundles marketing.

Let’s get started!

Glossier beauty and cosmetics product bundles: An in-depth analysis

Glossier is an online beauty and cosmetics brand that was started in 2014. The brand offers a wide range of beauty, skincare, make up, body care, and fragrance products. The brand aims to make beauty products accessible and uncomplicated for everyone.

In addition to individual products, Glossier also offers a range of sets or bundles on its websites. These fixed bundles include different types of products and variants and are a popular choice of customers.

Let’s look at the various features of Glossier bundles that make them so attractive and successful:

1. A dedicated page for bundles

Glossier has a dedicated page for sets/bundles. Shoppers can choose to see all the bundles or choose one of the two categories – Make up sets or Skincare sets. This page clearly displays all the bundles. Each bundle shows the products and the original price and the discounted bundle price.

Customers can click on ‘Choose set’ to see more details. The page further opens to a full-page that has more details about each of the products in the beauty and cosmetic product bundles.

Having a dedicated section/page for bundles makes it easy for customers to shop. Customers who want to buy multiple products would prefer to shop bundles and avoid looking at individual products.

Apart from streamlining and easy navigation for customers, having a dedicated bundles page also makes it easy for the brand to monitor and track bundles’ performance and related inventory.

2. Different categories for bundles

Glossier beauty and cosmetic product bundles are categorized into two segments – makeup and skincare.

Segregating bundles into these two categories helps in many ways. It simplifies customers’ shopping experience, saves time as customers only see products they are interested in, and streamlines the purchase process.

For Glossier, this segmentation helps streamline inventory management and their bundling process. Moreover, it makes promotions and marketing campaigns more focused and narrowed down. For instance, the brand can easily share on the bundles page link in marketing campaigns.

3. ‘Quick shop’ and ‘See full page’ options

Customers interested in buying Glossier beauty and cosmetic product bundles have two options. The first option: They can click on ‘Choose set’ below the product listing and buy the bundle from a small window that opens more details.

The second option: From the pop up window, click on ‘See full page’ that shares more details about each product of the bundle, ingredients used, how to apply the products, look book and reviews.

Providing these two options enhances customers’ shopping experience. Repeat customers may prefer the quick shop option, while new, first-time customers may want to read more information and then proceed to purchase the bundle.

Here’s the quick shop pop up page:

Here’s the full page:

4. Displays bundle recommendations

Product recommendations increase the probability of sales 4.5X. And 54% of retailers say displaying product recommendations is one of the key factors that drives average order value in customer purchase.

Glossier pays a lot of attention to sharing bundle recommendations. The brand shares product recommendations on each of its full page bundle product pages. Customers can buy the recommended products from the ‘You may also like’ section.

Moreover, this page also has a look book that complements the recommendations section. Customers who want to get a specific look from the look book can easily find those products in the recommendations section. Thus, driving sales and increasing AOV for Glosier.

6. Displays customer reviews

Another key element on eCommerce sites that helps increase customer engagement and sales is product reviews by customers. And Glossier does a great job with sharing reviews written by their customers.

What Glossier reviews section includes:

  • Total number of reviews
  • Average rating
  • A ‘Write a review’ tab
  • A search bar so customers can enter keywords and read relevant reviews
  • An option for viewers to give a thumbs up or down
  • An option to filter reviews – Newest first, highest rating, lowest rating, and most helpful

The best part about the reviews section is that the brand keeps all reviews. Unlike other brands that show only positive reviews, Glossier shows reviews even if they are negative. This helps build customer trust and helps them make better purchase decisions.

7. Glossier pays attention to detail

The brand understands that sharing detailed and as much information as possible can help customers purchase decisions easier. Customers are careful when buying beauty and cosmetics products as they are to be used on their skin and body. And hence, it helps when cosmetics brands share details.

Apart from product information, Glossier also pays attention to other elements that can help enhance customer experience. For instance, sharing reviews and recommendations to help customers make better purchase decisions.

8. Glossier prioritizes visibility of bundles

You may create the best Shopify beauty and cosmetics product bundles, but if your customers don’t notice them, your bundling strategy is pretty useless. Glossier understands the importance of making their bundles seen.

Here are the things that make their bundles seen:

  • A dedicated page for bundles
  • Clear images for each bundle
  • Neat presentation
  • Detailed information on each product of the bundles
  • Customer reviews and ratings
  • Bundle recommendations to introduce more bundles to customers

9. Allows customers to send bundle as gift

Glossier beauty and cosmetics product bundles can be easily sent as gifts. Customers can check the option at checkout and send the bundles to their friends and family.

Additionally, customers can also add a personalized message with the gift bundle. This feature helps improve their bundle sales, customer engagement, and helps the brand grow its customer base.

Moreover, Glossier combines its bundle gifting strategy with other offers and promotional campaigns, driving more sales and AOV.

10. Glossier has a clear bundle pricing strategy

One of the most important factors that customers consider when buying bundles is the price of the bundle.

Glossier displays their beauty and cosmetics product bundles’ prices at every step and stage of the purchase journey. From the listing on the product page to the page that shares all the details to the checkout page, every page shows the price and savings.

Not just that, the brand also shows the discounted bundle price next to the original price, clearly showing shoppers how much they save.

Moreover, every product page also mentions the percentage that customers would save with each bundle.

Key takeaways from Glossier beauty and cosmetics product bundle strategy

Here’s a summary of Glossier’s bundle strategy that makes it a successful business model for the brand and why their customers love their bundles so much.

  • Glossier has created a dedicated page for its bundles
  • The brand keeps it simple by offering bundles in two product categories
  • Customers can read all important details and information about the product on the bundles page
  • Every individual product of the bundles is described in detail
  • Clear images and descriptions make it easy for customers to understand the product
  • Their FAQs section clearly answers all basic questions
  • Customers can clearly see the price benefits and percentage of savings
  • Customers can send the bundles as gifts

Product bundles are popular amongst consumers. Bundles offer discounts and convenience among other benefits to customers. For eCommerce retailers, product bundles help increase average order value (AOV), improve brand loyalty, and inventory management.

There are different types of product bundles. In this blog, we focus on one type — variant product bundles. You’ll learn how to set up variant bundles, their benefits, best practices, and more.

Let’s get started!

What are variant product bundles

Product variant bundles are a selection of products or services put together and offered as a bundle. The items in a bundle can be different based on customer preferences. For instance, the core product remains the same but customers can create a customized version of the bundle. For example: instead of buying one notebook, a customer can choose to buy a bundle of 5 or 10 notebooks. Or, instead of just buying one pair of socks, a customer can buy three pairs of different styles and sizes and buy it as a bundle.

Benefits of variant/variable product bundles

Apart from increasing AOV, there are many more benefits of variable bundles. Let’s explore some more benefits in this section.

1. Increased customer satisfaction through customization

In variable bundles, customers can choose many different variants around a core product. Customers can buy their selection of products as a bundle at a discounted price. This ease of customization and the ability to buy the products they prefer at a discounted price leads to increased customer satisfaction, eventually leading to higher loyalty.

2. Enhanced upselling and cross-selling opportunities

With variant product bundles, you can upsell and cross-sell products related to the core product. For instance, if a customer is showing interest in buying a water cooler, you could cross-sell a yearly maintenance and cleaning service to them as a bundle, at a discounted price. This also helps increase your AOV and profits.

3. Improved inventory management and product turnover

Variable bundles also help with better inventory management. For instance, you can push products that are overstocked, products from the old stock, or products of a high value to increase the AOV.

4. Higher average order value

Shopify product bundles have a higher AOV compared to when products are bought individually. Even though the bundled products are offered at a discount, a bundles price is higher than individual products because it has multiple products. Variable bundles allow customers to select variants of products and hence, customers tend to buy more in one go.

Designing effective variable product bundles

Here are some actionable steps to design variant product bundles that customers will love and drive success for your business.

1. Structuring bundles with options for customization

For creating variable product bundles, start by selecting one core product. This is the product around which other products can be bundled. You can then include related products and services that can be added to the bundle. For example, these add-on products could be accessories, additional services, accessories, etc. that customers can choose based on their preference.

You can also create multiple tiers or levels of customization to match the needs of various customer segments. The pricing structure for multi-tier bundles can be flexible and variable based on the products selected by customers.

By incorporating real-time pricing adjustments based on the variable bundles created by customers, you can enhance customer experience on your Shopify store. Moreover, customers can also decide the products they want to buy based on their budget.

2. Presenting bundle choices clearly to customers

When listing and displaying bundles on your Shopify store, ensure you follow the best practices so your bundles get noticed. Use images, clear copy and description, videos, and show each product of the bundle.

Make the customization process easier by incorporating a user-friendly interface. Break down the selection process into easy steps. Starting with the core product, guide customers to select other products for the bundle.

Include filters and search tools to make it easy for customers to add products. Additionally, also provide comparison tools that allow customers to compare options. These features ensure speed, product relevance and informed decisions.

3. Ensuring a seamless experience in customizing bundles

Customers expect eCommerce brands to have advanced features that make their shopping experience easier. For instance, for your variant product bundles, you can have interactive configurators that enable real-time adjustments in product pricing, etc.

Customers often tend to use online chat services for assistance during shopping. Enable live chat support on the website, WhatsApp chat, etc. for a seamless experience. You can also enable product recommendations based on AI to show customers product options. Use an efficient Shopify product bundling app to automate these tasks.

Moreover, create a mobile-friendly interface for your Shopify store. Busy shoppers often shop on the go on their mobile devices. Hence, it is critical to make your Shopify product bundling strategy mobile friendly.

Step by step to set up variable product bundles

Follow these steps to get started with your variable bundles. Once you get the basics right, you can easily optimize and adjust your bundling strategy.

1. Decide your variable product bundle basics

When planning your product variant bundle, define clearly how you want to structure your bundle. How many products, what kind of products, and how many variables you want to offer in each bundle. Having clarity from the beginning will ensure you set up a robust bundling strategy. Pro tip: Use an efficient variant product bundling app built for Shopify.

2. Define your pricing strategy

Once you have clarity about your product bundling structure, it’s time to come up with strategic pricing methods. You can use multiple strategies for pricing. However, ensure it is beneficial to customers and keeps your bundles profitable. Refer to the next section for pricing ideas.

3. Create variant product bundle listings

Next, it’s time to list your Shopify product bundles on various platforms so reach out to your target audience. Your potential customers may be spread across channels, such as your website, third-party shopping websites, social media, etc. Create clear listings for your bundles on all channels.

4. Promote your product bundles

The best way to promote your Shopify product bundling is to display it on various platforms where your target audience spends time. Alongside, create promotional offers, such as seasonal discounts, offer incentives such as free shipping, etc.

5. Monitor and optimize variable bundles

To ensure your variable bundles remain relevant, monitor their performance and make adjustments. For instance, monitor factors such as sales, conversions, profits, etc. Make seasonal adjustments. Keep track of market trends and change your bundles accordingly.

Pricing strategies for variable bundles

To attract customers and drive sales of your variable product bundles, try these pricing strategies. Ensure you select the strategy that aligns with your products, target audience and business goals.

1. Base price with add-ons

This pricing structure is simple and straightforward — customers can add extra products in their variant product bundles at an additional cost. For example, a core product – t-shirt – can be bundled with a pair of socks, a belt, and a packet of handkerchiefs. The customer is charged the total amount minus any discount amount.

2. Tiered pricing

Offer different variant bundles with a tiered pricing structure. For example, Bundle A with 2 products, Bundle B with 3 products, and Bundle C with 4 products. Each tier can be priced based on the number of products and level of customization or additional products chosen by costumes.

3. Volume discounts

Another way to price your Shopify variable product bundles is based on the volume or the number of products. For example, buy 2 and get 5% discount, buy 3 and get 10% off. This pricing strategy helps increase sales as well as helps you sell overstocked products.

4. Percentage-based discounts

Percentage discounts can also be offered on the entire bundle. For instance, don’t offer discounts on individual products; rather offer a fixed percentage discount on the entire bundle. However, for this strategy, you must ensure you offer products that are feasible for you to offer in a bundle with percentage discount.

5. Fixed price for customization

For many retailers, variable prices might be tough to track. There’s a solution for that – fixed price for customization. For instance, allow customers to choose any three products for a flat discount of $20. In this structure, the discount amount remains constant, no matter the price of the products chosen.

6. Dynamic pricing

In a dynamic pricing structure, the price of the variable bundle changes based on the products selected by customers. The Shopify product bundle app will use algorithms and automate the price dynamically. For example, the price of a t-shirt bundle will adjust automatically based on the size and color selected.

7. Promotional pricing

One way to attract customers to variant product bundles is to offer promotional pricing. For example, limited-time discount or flash sale on variable bundles. Promotional pricing can help you promote bundles as well as clear overstocked inventory much faster.

8. Loyalty and membership pricing

Another pricing strategy for variable product bundles is to offer exclusive prices for loyal customers who have bought variable bundles regularly and for members who have joined your membership or subscription program. For instance, offer these customers an additional 10% discount.

9. Bundled savings guarantee

Use bundled sayings strategy based on your requirements. For instance, if you have products that are lying in your inventory for a long time and you know it’s going to be hard to sell them, offer bundled savings on them. For example, offer a bigger discount on purchase of a bundle with that specific product in it.

10. Subscription-based pricing

Another way to promote variable product bundles is via subscriptions. Make the variable bundle a part of your subscription offering. For example, offer a bundle every quarter. Or create bundle subscriptions. For instance, customers receive a new customizable product bundle every month.

Get started with your Shopify variant product bundling

Depending on your products, services, and your industry, you can set up relevant product variant bundling strategies for your Shopify store. Follow the above steps and strategies to ensure you get the basics right. Moreover, use an efficient bundling app that helps automate tasks and manages your bundling business 24/7.

items.html:
Subscription bundles are everywhere — from meal kit subscriptions to beauty and wellness bundles delivered periodically to entertainment subscriptions!

Subscription bundling is changing the way customers shop. For eCommerce retailers, subscription product box bundles ensure regular revenue and better inventory management.

In this blog, we break down every element of subscription bundling for your Shopify business.

Let’s get started!

What are subscription product bundles?

Subscription bundling involves a curated selection of products put together in a subscription model. For instance, these boxes bundle together products that are based on a theme or purpose. The products could be complementary or the same in multiple numbers. These boxes provide value and enhance subscribers’ experience. Some examples of a subscription box product bundle would be a subscription box of a curated selection of coffees or teas.

Here’s an example:

Key features of subscription product bundles

Why are subscription bundles becoming popular? What are the key elements that make them appealing to customers? And what are the features that brands can offer via subscription product bundles? We answer these questions in this section.

1. Curated collections

With subscription bundling, you can curate selected products in each delivery. This ensures a cohesive experience for customers. Personalized subscription bundles enhance the overall customer experience as the products are more relevant to customer preferences. This simplifies customers’ purchase decisions.

2. Value and savings for customers

One of the key features of subscription bundling is its special pricing and its value-add to customers. Subscribers typically get a discount on bundle subscription boxes compared to if they buy products separately. Apart from lower prices, bundle subscriptions also offer benefits such as free delivery and other incentives, which enhances the value of the subscription.

3. Themed or seasonal subscription bundling

Subscription bundling often involves creating bundles around themes or seasonal events, such as festivals, seasonal products, etc. This helps brands keep their subscription bundles relevant and fresh. Since there’s something new offered every time, customers remain engaged and excited. At the same time, it also brings a sense of urgency as customers do not want to miss out on different themes.

4. Exclusive or premium products

Depending on your product type, you can include exclusive and premium products in bundles that are not available separately outside of the bundle. For example, limited edition products, early bird access products, etc. Including exclusive products makes customers feel special and boosts brand loyalty. Additionally, premium products improve the overall value perception of the subscription product bundle on Shopify.

Bundle subscription vs. usual subscription model: the difference

It is easy to confuse subscription bundling with the usual subscription box model. However, the two are different in many ways. Here are the differences.

Benefits of subscription box product bundles

Today, customers want the best experiences from brands. And subscription bundling ensures that in many ways. Let’s look at some benefits of subscription box bundles.

1. Enhances customer experience

When you put together thoughtfully curated products that are relevant to customers, it directly enhances their perception and experience of your brand. Any level of personalization helps increase customer satisfaction. For instance, from the unboxing experience to using the products to waiting in anticipation for the next bundle, it builds a positive emotional connection.

2. Increases value per box

The most important benefit of bundles is its pricing and value. Bundles offer a selection of products at a much lesser price compared to what one would pay for individual products. This enhances the value of bundles as customers feel they are receiving more value at a lesser price.

3. Encourages loyalty and retention

Subscription bundling has many factors that lead to retained engagement. For instance, bundles that include relevant and thoughtful products keep customers’ interest going. Customers feel excited about receiving the next subscription bundle box. And as long as the subscription box meets their expectations, customers feel connected and stay committed for a long time.

4. More product discovery opportunities

With subscription box bundles, you can introduce new products to customers that they may not have seen before. For instance, if you have a new collection or if you’ve added a new brand in your inventory, you can improve its reach by adding it to your subscription bundle. This helps customers try and explore new products. This also enhances future sales potential for the new products.

Considerations for creating subscription box product bundles

Consider these aspects to ensure your subscription bundling strategy covers all key requirements.

1. Product selection

One of the first factors to consider when creating a subscription bundling model for your Shopify store is the products. Subscribers won’t renew subscriptions if the products don’t excite them. Here’s how you can retain subscribers by ensuring the right products:

  • If you’re creating multiple bundles, keep them simple so that customers don’t face decision paralysis
  • Choose products that complement each other and enhance the usefulness of the bundle
  • Personalize the bundles by including products that interest your customers
  • Choose products that allow you to offer discount and still ensure profitability
  • Mix less-popular products with star products to help manage inventory

Here’s an example of a beauty subscription bundle:

2. Pricing and cost management

Bundles appeal to customers for their discounted pricing—51% of consumers who prefer savings opt for subscription bundles. However, there are a lot of factors you will have to consider in order to ensure pricing that is best for your business and customers. Here are some tips for subscription bundling:

  • Ensure your subscription product bundle pricing is competitive
  • Emphasize on discounts, savings, and other benefits
  • Combine high-value and low-value products to maintain AOV
  • Monitor market and competition to adjust your bundle pricing
  • Consider seasonal and festive changes for pricing

3. Packaging and presentation

While many brands focus more on creating the best bundles with top products, they ignore a key element – packaging. How you present and package your subscription bundles can have a huge impact on customer experience. Keep these cues in mind:

  • Ensure attractive and creative packaging and presentation
  • Package bundles in a way that enhances the unboxing experience
  • The package should reflect the bundle theme and your brand
  • Use advanced tactics such as sharing a QR code for bundle reviews on the packaging
  • Use eco-friendly packaging to cater to a growing number of conscious consumers

4. Regular updates

The market keeps changing with new products and trends. And customers, too, expect something new from their favorite brands. In such a scenario, if your subscription bundling remains monotonous, subscribers may soon lose interest. Here’s what you must do:

  • Refresh your Shopify product bundle subscriptions regularly with new products
  • Ensure your subscription bundles remain relevant to customers as trends change
  • Keep subscriptions exciting by continuously adding new elements, new products, etc.
  • Collect customer feedback and reviews to understand the changes customers would like in the subscription bundles

Step by step to set up subscription bundling

Follow these actionable steps to get started with your subscription product bundles by making adjustments to align to your products and business goals.

1. Decide your subscription bundle type

Choose from the different types of subscription bundles. For instance, fixed bundles, tiered bundle structure, etc. Here are some things to consider:

  • Bundles complementing products to make the bundle more useful
  • Select from different bundle types – tiered bundles, advanced bundles, premium bundles, etc.
  • Offer multiple bundle types to cater to diverse customer segments
  • Offer multi-tier bundles to increases the potential of customers upgrading to higher-value subscription product bundles
  • Use an efficient Shopify product bundle app that offers a wide range of bundle structures

2. Define your subscription bundling pricing strategy

Pricing is one of the most critical factors when setting up subscription bundles. Consider these strategies:

  • Price the subscription box bundle to offer value to customers
  • The pricing should be beneficial to both customer and your business
  • The bundle price should be lower than the combined price of individual products
  • Monitor pricing and profit margins continuously and make adjustments
  • Offer tiered pricing – premium subscription bundles at a higher price but with more discounts and savings

3. Create subscription bundle listings

Once the pricing strategy is set, list your subscription product bundles on various platforms so that customers become aware of them.

  • List the bundles on your website clearly
  • Highlight subscription bundles on your website with a dedicated page
  • Make the listing visually appealing with images and highlighting savings
  • Write clear and concise description and details
  • Highlight the benefits – discounts, savings, other value-add benefits
  • List your bundles on third-party websites as well

Here’s an example:

4. Promote your subscription product bundles

The best way to promote your subscription bundling products is to display them on platforms where your target audience spends time.

  • Promote bundles on various pages on your website
  • Create pop up notifications on your website and third-party websites
  • Promote subscription product bundles on social media via campaigns
  • Use other methods, such as paid ads, contests, etc.

5. Monitor and optimize subscription bundles

The market is always changing. To ensure your bundles remain relevant, monitor their performance and make adjustments. Do this:

  • Measure basic KPIs — sales, conversions, profits, subscription renewals, etc.
  • Monitor which bundles perform well and which ones don’t and make necessary adjustments
  • Collect customer feedback and reviews to understand customer sentiment around your subscription bundles

Ready to start your Shopify subscription bundling?

An increasing number of consumers are opting for subscription product bundles, not only for the price benefits and savings, but also for the convenience subscriptions offer.

To improve your Shopify sales and customer experience, you can start subscription bundles on your store. And to make it easy, use Appstle Bundles and Discounts – a Shopify product bundle app that helps in setting up bundles and managing them with automated features.
